name: "Heal Me" Minestrone Soup
description: There are few soups better than a minestrone, and this minestrone soup recipe from Alfie Steiner (aka @alfiecooks_) is pure comfort in a bowl. Guaranteed to make you feel better, whatever the weather, it’s packed full of your favourite veggies and juicy legumes, making it incredibly good for you too. An absolute winter staple.
instructions: Finely dice the onion, carrot, celery and potato, then mince the garlic. In a large saucepan, heat a glug of olive oil on a medium heat. Once warmed, add the onion, carrot, celery and potato with a large pinch of salt. Sauté for 5-10 mins until softened and catching the pan, then add the garlic, frying until fragrant.

Add the tomato purée with the oregano, paprika and chilli flakes, cooking out for another 2-3 mins. Add in your wine and let that cook out for a bit too. Add the butter beans, chopped tomatoes and vegetable stock, then season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Lower the heat to a simmer for 10-15 mins.
Add the pasta and cook following packet instructions until almost al dente. Once cooked, chuck in the spinach and basil, allowing to wilt.
To serve, spoon into bowls, top with fresh basil, olive oil, nutritional yeast and more chilli flakes. Enjoy!

name: "Marry Me" Gochujang Chicken Noodles
description: A spicy take on the viral ‘marry me’ chicken using gochujang and sundried tomatoes to make a quick and indulgent dinner.
instructions: Finely dice your onion, mince your garlic, chop both your chives (for the noodles, and the panko topping) and thinly slice the mushrooms.
Pound the chicken to an even thickness and season both sides with salt, pepper and garlic powder.

Heat a glug of vegetable oil in a large frying pan set over a medium heat. Add the chicken and pan fry it for 6-8 mins on each side, depending on thickness, until cooked through. Don't overcrowd the pan; do it in batches if necessary.

While the chicken cooks, bring a large pot of salted water to the boil, add the tagliatelle and cook until al dente following packet instructions. Drain the tagliatelle, reserving a mug of the pasta cooking water, and rinse the tagliatelle in cold water.

Meanwhile, add the butter, onion and garlic to another large pan set over a medium heat. Fry for a few minutes until softened then add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their moisture and become tender (this should take about 5 mins).

Add the chilli oil, gochujang, tomato purée to the pan and mix to combine. Stir through the double cream and sundried tomatoes. Add the honey and the juice of the lime. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let it gently bubble away while the pasta and chicken finish cooking.
Add the cooked noodles and a ladle of the pasta water to the sauce. Season with salt and pepper and add the chives then mix to combine.
To make the chive panko, melt butter in a pan, then add the chopped chives and panko. Stir well to combine and cook until the panko is golden and crispy.
To serve, divide the tagliatelle between bowls then top with chicken, panko and some extra chilli oil.

name: "Marry Me" Margarita
description: A romantic cocktail that's perfect for a low-lit night in.
instructions: Start by separating a quarter of your strawberries and slice them thinly (the thinner they are the quicker they will de-hydrate) and place them in an oven on 60°C for 3-4 hours until bone dry, or an air-fryer on the dehydrate setting.
When these are dehydrated, blend them until they reach a confetti-like texture and set aside. Juice your limes and blend your remaining strawberries into a purée.
In a pan, gently dissolve your sugar in your water over a low heat. Do not boil. Mix a pinch of salt in with 10ml of water and dissolve.
Prepare your drinking glass by rubbing a lime on the rim and then coating in the strawberry confetti.
Using a peeler, peel the skin of the orange then, with a paring knife, cut out three to four small hearts which can be stuck through a cocktail stick as optional garnish.

Get a cocktail shaker and add in your ice, your berry purée, tequila, cointreau, lime juice, half of your sugar syrup and a teaspoon of your saline solution (this is just as there is no salty rim but you still want those flavours to balance out).
Shake vigorously and double strain over into your glass over ice.
Garnish with your orange hearts and enjoy.

name: "Please Don't Leave Me" Chicken
description: This stunning chicken dish is the recipe that's saved Jamie Laing and Sophie Habboo's marriage on more than one occasion.
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C. Season the chicken thighs with salt.

Heat a large frying pan over a medium heat. Put the chicken thighs into the pan, skin-side down, and cook for 8-10 mins until the skin is deep golden brown. Transfer to a baking tray and add the cherry tomatoes.
Drain the sundried tomatoes and peel the garlic. Add both to a blender with the tomato purée, paprika, fennel seeds, chilli, wine and chicken stock. Blend until completely smooth.

Pour the sauce into the now-empty chicken pan, making sure to scrape all the chicken-y bits from the bottom. Bring to the boil, then pour over the chicken and tomatoes. Transfer the baking tray to the oven and cook for 25-30 mins.
Meanwhile, pick the basil leaves, discarding the stems.

Once the chicken is cooked, remove from the tray and swirl the cream through the sauce. Taste and season with salt and pepper and place the chicken back into the sauce. Garnish with the basil to serve.

Cook the pasta according to package instructions and combine with the sauce. We went with rigatoni but you can feel free to use anything you'd like - rice, quinoa, barley, potatoes. It's completely up to you.

name: 'Nduja & Anchovy Spaghetti
description: Spicy, salty and glossy in all the right ways. This spaghetti makes use of the king of the store cupboard – tinned anchovies. With the heat of 'nduja too this is a midweek pasta with serious attitude.
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil.
Meanwhile, finely slice the garlic. Finely chop most of the parsley, saving a few leaves to serve. Then add the spaghetti to the boiling water and cook for 2 mins less than pack instructions.
Whilst the spaghetti cooks, place a large frying pan over a medium heat and add a big glug of olive oil. Add the ’nduja and let it melt for 2-3 mins, stirring so it turns glossy.
Add the garlic and anchovies, then cook for 2-3 mins, stirring, until the anchovies have melted into the oil. Turn the heat down and zest the lemon straight into the pan.

Use tongs to transfer the cooked spaghetti straight into the frying pan with a big splash of the pasta water. Toss everything together for 1-2 mins until the sauce clings to the spaghetti, adding more pasta water if it needs it.

Squeeze in ½ the lemon juice and grate in most of the parmesan, saving a little to serve. Add the parsley then toss again, adding a little more pasta water if you need to. Taste and season with salt and plenty of black pepper.

Divide between bowls and finish with another grind of black pepper and the remaining parmesan cheese grated over. Scatter with the remaining parsley leaves. Serve with the remaining lemon half, cut into wedges.

name: 'Nduja & Manchego Sausage Rolls
description: 'Nduja in sausage rolls - why isn't this more of a thing? The most natural partnership in the world. Topped with fennel seeds, these are divine.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C/356°F.
Add a drizzle of olive oil to a frying pan. Dice the onions, add 1 tsp of fennel seeds and chop up your rosemary and add to the pan. Cook until the onions are translucent.

Place your cooked onions into a bowl and add your ‘nduja paste and squeeze out the meat from your sausage. Next, grate the zest of your orange, 100g of Manchego, a sprinkle of salt and pepper and mix together thoroughly with your hands.

Take your pastry and cut it in half (longways). Create a long sausage in the middle of your pastry, leaving about 2cm around the edge. Sprinkle half of your remaining manchego over the top of the sausage.

Whisk your yolks in a separate cup, take a brush and cover the edge of the pastry in the whisked yolks. Fold your pastry over the sausage and seal the edges using a fork. Brush the top of the pastry with your egg yolk wash, sprinkle some salt and some fennel seeds on the top. Repeat with the other half of your pastry. Cut the sausage rolls into 16 evenly sized smaller sausage rolls. Bake for 45 minutes.
Once cooked, take them out of the oven and share with your MOB.

name: 'Nduja Baked Camembert
description: Spicy 'nduja and camembert turned molten after their spell in a hot oven. Crisp garlic bread to dunk. There is no better baked camembert than this. Sophie x
instructions: Heat your oven to 180°C/354°F.
Unwrap your camembert and cut a circle out in the middle. Stuff the ‘nduja into the hole in the camembert, then pop the cut out circle back on top. Pop your camembert back into its wooden tray.
Cut your ciabatta into sticks.
Finely chop your parsley and grate your garlic. Combine in a bowl with a good glug of olive oil.

Place your camembert in the centre of a large baking tray and surround it with your breadsticks. Drizzle the garlicky, herby oil over the breadsticks along with a pinch of salt, then toss with your hands until they are all coated.
Bake for 15 minutes, then serve immediately.

name: 'Nduja Butter Fried Egg
description: Melting a blob of honey and 'nduja butter and letting your fried eggs crisp up in there is going to change your breakfast game. Spicy, sweet and savoury.
instructions: Add your softened butter to a bowl, and mix in your ‘nduja, honey and dried oregano.
Pop your toast in the toaster.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add a heaped tbsp of your butter mixture and let it melt and sizzle.
Crack an egg into the pan and season the top with salt. Let the whites bubble up and the base of the egg go crispy.
Rub the toast in the pan to butter it, then pop it on a plate. Top with your fried egg and some chopped chives. Enjoy!

name: 'Nduja Chicken Milanese
description: Essentially, an enormous chicken nugget with tomato pasta but with the flavours levelled up big time. 'Nduja is melted into the tomato sauce for a fiery kick.
instructions: Add the extra virgin olive oil and finely grated garlic to a cold frying pan. Turn up the heat until the garlic wiggles and dances, then throw in half of the thyme leaves and ‘nduja and cook until fragrant (1-2 mins).

Pour in the tinned tomatoes, a tin full of water, a good pinch of salt and pepper and simmer until reduced, around 20 mins. Season with sherry vinegar (and maybe a pinch of sugar) until the sauce is fiery, balanced and tangy.
In the meantime, place the chicken breast between two pieces of parchment paper, season with salt and bash with something heavy until flattened and thin.
In a shallow bowl, mix the oregano and crispy onions with the remaining thyme leaves and most of the Parmesan with the panko breadcrumbs.

Sprinkle flour directly on the chicken on the parchment to coat (to save on washing up). Crack the eggs into another shallow bowl and season with a pinch of salt. Transfer the floured chicken into the egg mixture, then through the breadcrumbs to coat and set aside.
Bring a large pan of water to the boil and salt generously. Boil the spaghetti until al dente, around 8-9 mins.

Pour enough neutral oil into a large frying pan to coat the base of the pan around 1cm. Shallow fry the chicken fillets until golden brown, around 2 and a half mins on each side. Rest for 2 mins on a chopping board, sprinkle with flaky salt and the lemon zest and slice into strips.

To bring everything together, toss the spaghetti with the spicy tomato sauce with a big glug of pasta water and serve with the sliced chicken fillets, lots of fresh basil leaves, the remaining grated Parmesan and a big squeeze of fresh lemon.

name: 'Nduja Chicken Traybake
description: Traybake dinners are the best thing. You bake the chicken on top of bread so it soaks up all the juices and gets wonderfully crispy on the base.
instructions: Heat a frying pan over a medium heat. Season the chicken skin with salt, then pop them skin side down in the pan. Fry for 5 mins until the skin is golden brown and some of the fat has rendered down.
Meanwhile, slice your sourdough into 1 inch slices, and quarter your tomatoes. Preheat your oven to 200°C.
Place your sliced bread into a roasting tray. Top with your chicken legs and tomatoes, then drizzle with olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast for 30 mins.
Remove your tray from the oven and baste your chicken with any juices in the base. Add your ‘nduja and bake for another 15 mins.
Get your chicken legs out of the pan to rest. Take your bread slicedout, then add them to a plate.

Get your roasting tray with all the juices and tomatoes in it back on the hob. Add your chicken stock and simmer for 5 mins, then add your crème fraîche. Mix to combine, then season to taste with salt and pepper.
Once the sauce is looking good, load your chicken onto your bread along with a spoon of your sauce and a generous scattering of basil leaves.

name: 'Nduja Courgettes
description: Very proud of this one. 'Nduja with charred, grilled courgettes. Keep the courgettes nice and chunky so they keep their bite. A beautiful side dish.
instructions: Chop the courgettes into thumb-sized chunks. It’s very important to keep the courgette nice and chunky so they have lots of bite.
Heat a griddle pan so it is piping hot, add the courgette and cook until charred.
Slice the garlic and add into a frying pan with a splash of olive oil. As it starts to go translucent add your ‘nduja paste. Let this bubble, fry for 30 seconds then add your white wine.
Reduce the wine down then toss in the courgette. Stir through.
Chop up your parsley and add into the pan along with a squeeze of lemon juice and salt. Then, dig in!

name: 'Nduja Fried Rice
description: And you thought we couldn't smash ‘nduja into any more recipes? This is a perfect, spicy, meaty fried rice for one. Go on, treat yourself.
instructions: Start by chopping the red pepper, roughly chopping the parsley and mincing the garlic. Next, set a frying pan over a medium-high heat and add the 'nduja and a splash of olive oil.
Break up the 'nduja with a wooden spoon as it cooks and then add the garlic. Fry gently for a couple of minutes then add the tomato purée.
Cook for a minute or so to take the bitterness out of the tomato purée then add the chopped pepper.
Turn up the heat and season. Break up the rice in the bag then pour it into the pan.
Stir everything together, allowing the rice to take on a lovely red colour and cook for a couple of mins. Stir through the parsley then plate up.
Serve with the lemon cut into wedges and a drizzle of sour cream, if you fancy.

name: 'Nduja Roast Potatoes
description: Perhaps the most Mob recipe… ever. 'Nduja gives the crispy roasties a spicy kick, with some zingy lemon juice and fragrant rosemary. Jordon x
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C.
Peel and quarter the potatoes, then place into a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil and par cook for about 10 mins until the outside of the potatoes is just softening.
While the potatoes parboil, pour about 100ml of olive oil into a large baking tray and place into the oven for 5 minutes to heat up.
Once the potatoes are ready, drain and allow to steam dry for a minute, then pour into the hot roasting tray, season with salt and place into the oven to roast for 45 mins.
After 45 mins, remove the potatoes. Finely chop the rosemary and add along with the 'nduja. Mix well and roast for another 5 mins until the nduja has melted and the potatoes are crispy.
Remove from the oven, squeeze over the lemon, add another pinch of salt and mix well.

name: 'Nduja Scotch Egg
description: Mixing the 'nduja through the sausage meat is one of the simplest yet most brilliant food ideas since sliced bread. The crispy shell. The runny egg. Sublime.
instructions: Finely chop your herbs. In a bowl combine the sausage meat, ’Nduja, salt, pepper, and your chopped herbs. Mix together and place in the fridge.
Get some water on the boil. Add 4 of your eggs, boil for 6 mins, remove from the heat and place in a bowl of icy water for 2 minutes.
Take the eggs out and peel off the shells.
Get three bowls - fill one with flour, crack 2 eggs into the second and whisk and breadcrumbs into third. Add a pinch of salt to all bowls.
Cover the boiled eggs in flour and place on a board.

Remove the sausage meat from the fridge. Divide your meat into 4 balls, pat into a patty shape and pop your egg on top then mould the sausage meat around the egg until you have a nice smooth ball shape.
Dip the balls in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs until evenly coated.

Fill a saucepan with veg oil and heat. Add a few breadcrumbs - once they start bubbling, its ready (you want it on a nice medium heat, not too hot otherwise it will burn). Add your scotch egg and cook for 10 mins until golden brown.
Remove from heat, lay on kitchen roll to absorb any leftover oil. Cut it open and tuck into this beauty.

name: 'Nduja Seafood Spaghetti
description: A quick and simple pasta recipe that's packed with acid and spice. This is the perfect thing to eat during the summer.
instructions: Thinly slice the garlic.
Add your pasta to salted boiling water.
Add a large glug of oil to a pan and add in the garlic and anchovies and cook for 1 min. Add in the tomato purée and 'nduja and cook for 5 mins until the oil is stained red.
Squeeze in the juice of the lemon and 100ml of pasta water.
Toss in the cooked pasta and the raw seafood and allow to cook for 2 mins until its all cooked through and the sauce is glossy.
Finish with the torn basil and Parmesan and serve.

name: 'Nduja Spatchcock Chicken
description: Spicy Italian 'nduja paste takes all the hard work out of a roast. Served with buttery potatoes and garlic mayo, this dish is one of the best.
instructions: Pre-heat your oven to 180°C/356°F.
Pop your potatoes in a pot of cold water with a large pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook for 10 mins until the potatoes are just fork-tender.
In a bowl, add in your smoked paprika, the juice of a lemon, 2 tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp salt and pepper. Mix well and grate in 3 cloves of garlic.
Place your remaining garlic cloves with the peel in foil, drizzle them in olive oil and add a pinch of salt. Close the foil packet so it's tightly sealed.
Spatchcock your chicken by using a pair of scissors and cutting along either side of the spine. Remove the spine and flip the bird around and press firmly on the breast.
Using a spoon, separate the skin from the chicken and stuff the chicken with the 'nduja paste.
Rub the outside of the chicken with the paprika mix.
Pour the potatoes into a baking dish and add in your dried thyme, a large glug of oil, salt and pepper. Rub that seasoning into them well and smash the potatoes with the back of a saucepan.
Place your chicken on top of your potatoes and roast in the oven for 1 hour or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, finely chop your parsley.
Once the chicken is roasted, remove the garlic from the foil and blend it with the mayo. Mix in half of the parsley and a pinch of salt.
Serve by sprinkling on the remaining chopped parsley and drizzling some of your roasted garlic mayo on top with those delicious roasty juices.

name: 'Nduja, Olive & Caper Spaghetti
description: 'Nduja + olives + capers = all the good stuff. This spaghetti is seriously good. One to impress your friends. A classic pasta recipe.
instructions:
Pour the boiling water from the kettle into a large saucepan over
the heat and bring back to the boil. Season the water well with
salt, then drop in the spaghetti. Cook for 1 minute less than the
packet instructions say to.
Meanwhile, roughly chop the olives. Get a large frying pan over a
high heat and drizzle in a good glug of olive oil. Add the 'nduja to
the pan and fry, smooshing with the back of your spoon to break
it up, for 1–2 mins. Crush and add the garlic and
cook, stirring, for a minute more.
Pour in the passata and a splash of balsamic vinegar glaze.
Season with salt and black pepper. Bring to the boil, then scrape
in the chopped olives and add the capers. Let the sauce bubble
away until the pasta is ready. Try the sauce, adding more balsamic
and/or seasoning to taste.
Use tongs to transfer the spaghetti straight from the saucepan
to the frying pan. Toss everything together, then divide between
four bowls. Tear over the basil and serve with a hunk of Parmesan
on the side ready for grating over.

name: 10 Minute Peanut Butter Noodles
description: A really delicious, quick noodle dish. The salty crunch of the peanuts scattered on top is divine.
instructions: Bash up your peanuts with the back of a knife and set aside.
Slice your ginger into strips, and finely slice your red chilli. Throw them into a hot wok with a good glug of vegetable oil.
Allow to soften, and then add your cloves of crushed garlic.

Mix together, and then add most of the finely sliced spring onions. Allow to soften, and then throw in the chopped pak choi stalks (save the leaves for later) and leave to cook for 3 minutes until softened .
Mix it up, and then add your peanut butter. Mix with the vegetables, and then add vegetable stock. Once the peanut butter has dissolved, allow the sauce to bubble away for 2 minutes.
At this point, add your honey and soy sauce.
Mix together, and then throw in your rice noodles. Move them around in the sauce, and then add your pak choi leaves.
Chop the coriander. Add to the noodles along with the lime juice.
Once the pak choi leaves have wilted, about 30 seconds - add a large handful of chopped peanuts, mix them in, and then remove the wok from the heat.
Serve the noodles in a bowl, and top with more peanuts, the rest of the spring onion and coriander leaves! Enjoy!

name: 10-Minute Smoky Harissa Creamy Butter Beans
description: The quickest, most satisfying lunch or light dinner that’s on the table in just 10 minutes. It’s quick, it’s healthy and it’s very delicious.
keywords: 10-Minute Smoky Harissa Creamy Butter Beans recipe
instructions: Add the cherry tomatoes to a pan with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt. Set it over a medium-high heat and cook for about 5 mins until starting to soften and burst open. Add a splash of water if they’re catching on the bottom of the pan.
Mince the garlic and add it to the tomatoes in the pan along with the tomato paste, ¾ of the harissa and the smoked paprika.

Add the tinned butterbeans and ½ their liquid to the pan then stir in the vegan cream cheese. Bring the mixture to a boil then turn down the heat and simmer for 5-10 mins until the beans have softened and the broth has thickened (it should be creamy). Season generously with salt to taste.
Meanwhile, toast the bread and finely chop the herbs.
To serve, ladle the beans into bowls. Drizzle over the tahini and some remaining harissa. Finish with the chopped herbs, flaked almonds and the toast on the side.

name: 10-Veg Minestrone
description: A sultry minestrone soup recipe packed with pretty much every vegetable you can think of. Yes, even that one.
instructions: Finely chop the onions, garlic, carrot, celery and rosemary leaves. Cut the leek into rounds. Preheat a saucepan over a medium heat and add a glug of olive oil. Tip in the veggies and sauté with a pinch of salt for 5-6 mins. Tip in the tomatoes, Parmesan rind and stock. Bring to a simmer and let blip away for 10-15 mins.
Now add the pasta and cook for another 8 mins or so. Finish with the peas and green beans for the last 2-3 mins. Season with salt and black pepper.
Serve with grated Parm and fresh basil leaves.

name: 15-Minute Saucy Sesame Noodles
description: These are my emergency noodles when I really can't be bothered to cook anything. The veg cooks with the noodles and the sauce is made in the bowl you eat from, so there's minimal washing up too. Plus they make great leftovers.
instructions: Start by building your sauce straight in the serving bowls or meal prep containers. Equally divide the miso, tahini, rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and sesame oil in each bowl and mix well to combine. Loosen with a splash of water until you have the consistency of double cream.

Cut the Tenderstem broccoli into 3cm pieces and dice the smoked tofu. Get a pot of salted water on to boil. Add the noodles, then drop in the Tenderstem when there are 3 mins of cook time left. Drain, saving some of the cooking water, then rinse them under cold water.

Divide the noodles and broccoli between the serving bowls or contaners and give everything a good mix. Add a splash of the cooking water if you need to loosen it. Top with the diced tofu, crispy chilli oil, coriander and sesame seeds. If you're making ahead box up your containers and store in the fridge for up to 2 days.

name: 15-Minute Saucy Sesame Noodles
description: This is my emergency dinner when I really can't be bothered to cook anything after work. The veg cooks with the noodles and the sauce is made in the bowl you eat from, so there's minimal washing up too. Deliciously easy carbs, protein and veg. Bish, bash, bosh.
instructions: Start by building your sauce straight in the serving bowls. Equally divide the miso, tahini, rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and sesame oil in each bowl and mix well to combine. Loosen with a splash of water until you have the consistency of double cream.

Cut the Tenderstem broccoli into 3cm pieces and dice the smoked tofu. Get a pot of salted water on to boil. Add the noodles, then drop in the Tenderstem when there are 3 mins of cook time left. Drain, saving some of the cooking water, then rinse them under cold water.

Divide the noodles and broccoli between the serving bowls and give everything a good mix. Add a splash of the cooking water if you need to loosen it. Top with the diced tofu, crispy chilli oil, coriander and sesame seeds. That's it!

name: 20-Minute Chicken Soup
description:
In Partnership With Aldi. #ad

Inspired by hot and sour soup, this chicken soup is incredibly spicy and comforting. Plus, you can make it under half an hour.
instructions: Prepare the chicken stock according to the package instructions and tip into a saucepan. Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Add the soy and then drop the chicken thighs in for 9-10 mins, or until the chicken is completely cooked.

Remove the chicken from the broth and cut into bite size pieces. Bring the broth back to a boil and drop the noodles in for 2 mins before adding the peas and tenderstem broccoli. Once cooked, remove from the heat and add the chicken back to the pan.

Thinly slice the spring onions and chillies and set aside. Finish the broth with the juice of one lime and then divide between large bowls. Serve topped with the sliced spring onions, chillies and extra lime wedges.

name: 3 Ingredient Creamy Pasta
description: Three ingredients, 10 minutes, dinner is served. This easy and creamy vegan pasta is to die for.
instructions: Cook your pasta as per instructions.

Empty the tin of butter beans with the liquid into a shallow, wide saucepan. 
Add 3 tbsp of vegan cream cheese and simmer for 5-6 mins on a low heat, stirring occasionally, until the butterbean liquid and the cream cheese have turned into a creamy sauce. The butter beans should be softened.
Chop the herbs.

Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of pasta water to the side. Add the pasta and most of the herbs, if using, to the sauce and stir well. Add a little pasta water if the sauce is too thick and season well.
Serve with plenty of herbs on top, if using.

name: 3-Ingredient Banana Pancakes
description: Start your day off properly with these super quick and healthy banana pancakes. Made with just three ingredients, they couldn’t be easier to make.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a blender then add the bananas and oats. Turn the blender onto a medium speed and blitz for 1-2 mins until the mixture is homogeneous and semi-smooth. Let it sit for 3 mins.
Warm a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Once hot, turn the heat down to low and add a small knob of butter. Once melted, add 4 tbsp of the mixture (for one large pancake).

Cook over a low heat for 1-2 mins until bubbles begin to appear. Flip and cook for another minute on the other side. Remove to a plate and cover with kitchen foil (or pop in the bottom shelf of a warm oven) to keep warm until serving. Repeat for the remaining mixture.
Serve with your choice of toppings! More banana slices, peanut butter and flaked toasted almonds are great.

name: 40 Clove Garlic Mushroom Lasagne
description: Be warned, you won’t be kissing anyone after this. 4 bulbs of roasted garlic layered with mushrooms and a creamy cheese sauce. Heaven.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Chop the ends off your bulbs of garlic and your shallots. Chop the shallots in half and drizzle them liberally with oil. Wrap your bulbs of garlic tightly in foil and roast for 1 hour.
Grate the parmesan.
Melt 4 tbsp of butter in a pot and then whisk in the flour. Slowly drizzle in the milk to form a thick sauce. Add in the mozzarella and mix well. Season with salt and pepper.
Finely chop the sage and parsley.
Roughly chop up the mushrooms and add them to a large pot with the remaining butter and 1 tsp of salt. Sauté for 15 mins until softened. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the shallots and garlic are roasted, pop them in a blender with 200ml of water and ¼ of the mushroom mix and 2 tbsp of the bechamel sauce. Blend until very smooth, there should be no fibrous bits, add more water if necessary.
Add the garlic liquid to the mushrooms and cook on a low heat to make a thick sauce.
Mix in the sage and parsley.

Layer a lasagne dish first with a thin layer of mushrooms, then a thin layer of béchamel and then the lasagne sheets. Repeat with thin layers of the filling, ending on a layer of béchamel. Finish with the parmesan.
Pop into the oven for 30 mins, allow to rest for 15 mins and then serve.

name: 5-Ingredient Cherry Pie
description: A classic, yet simple, pie with only 5 ingredients. The perfect weekend project.
instructions: Combine the frozen cherries and the sugar (reserve 1 tbsp of sugar), corn flour, with ½ tsp of salt in a large bowl. Allow to sit for 1 hour, stirring occasionally so the cherries release their liquid.
Strain the cherry from the liquid and heat up the liquid in a saucepan for 10 mins until thickened. Add the thickened liquid back in the bowl with the cherries and allow this to cool fully.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Divide the block of pastry in half. Roll one half until it's about 1cm thick and slightly larger in diameter than your pie tin.
Gently place the pastry sheet onto the pie dish and press down so it covers the base.
Pour the cherry filling into the lined pie dish.
Roll out the other half of the pastry to the same size as before and cut it into 4cm wide strips. You want about 10 strips.

Place five strips of pastry in a row across the top of your pie, ensuring they are evenly spaced apart. Fold back the first, third and fifth pastry strip in the row, then add another strip of pastry horizontally across. Place the lifted strips back down, then lift up the alternate two. Place another pastry strip horizontally across, then repeat these steps with your remaining pastry to create a lattice pattern.Trim the excess pastry from the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry in and then crimp the edges.
Crack an egg into a bowl and whisk it with a fork.
Gently brush the egg over the pastry and then pop it into the oven for 30 mins or until the crust is golden brown.
Allow the pie to cool for at leasr 3 hours. It must be fully chilled before slicing so the inside can firm up and the bottom stays crisp.
Serve with warm custard and enjoy.

name: 5-Ingredient Chilli Tahini Noodles
description: You can make this simple recipe in under 10 minutes. A quick and easy tahini noodles recipe.
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil.
Combine your crispy chilli oil and tahini in a bowl.
Cut your pak choi into quarters lengthways.
Once your water is boiling, add your instant noodle seasoning. Tip in your noodles and pak choi, then simmer for 3 mins.
Add your tahini chilli mixture to the base of your serving bowl. Add a few ladles of your broth, then mix to combine.
Add a little more broth if necessary, then tong in your noodles. Add your pak choi on top, then sprinkle over your sesame seeds and drizzle on your remaining chilli oil. Serve and enjoy!

name: 5-Ingredient Kebabs
description: Juicy and tender lamb kebabs that you can make in just a few minutes with only 5 ingredients and minimal effort.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Finely chop up the mint.
Grate the onion into a bowl using a box grater and then add in the lamb mince, harissa and mint.
Mix the lamb really well for 5 mins so it becomes very well mixed - this will help the fat emulsify.
Roll the lamb into 10 evenly sized sausages and place onto an oven-proof rack.
Pop the rack onto a tray and bake for 4 mins.
Take the tray out of the oven and turn the kebabs. Pop your flatbread onto the baking tray underneath the rack so they can soak up the lamb juices. Bake for another 4 mins.
Remove from the oven and enjoy the kebabs with the soft flatbread and your favourite toppings.

name: 5-a-day Shredded Chicken Salad
description: Stop worrying about lunch. This high-protein, 5-a-day salad is genuinely worth making at the start of the week - shredded chicken, crunchy veg and a creamy peanut dressing that gets better as it sits.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Add the chicken breasts to a baking tray, drizzle with a little olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Slide into the oven and cook for 20 mins, until cooked through, then set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, peel and shred the carrots using a peeler (or a julienne peeler if you have one) straight into a large mixing bowl. Shred the cabbage and radishes using a knife or a mandoline and add to the bowl. Finely dice the red peppers, and thinly slice the celery, drain the chickpeas and pick the herb leaves, then add everything to the bowl along with the edamame beans.

Make the dressing. Add the peanut butter to a bowl with the juice of the lemon and mix well - it'll clump up at first, don't worry. Slowly add water a splash at a time (you'll need quite a lot) until it forms a creamy dressing.
Shred the chicken and add to the bowl. Roughly chop most of the peanuts and add to the bowl, saving a few for the top.

When ready to eat, pour the dressing over the salad and toss well. Taste and season with salt and black pepper. Finish with a drizzle of chilli oil and a scatter of the remaining peanuts.If you're meal prepping, pile the prepped veg and shredded chicken into meal prep boxes and dress on the day.

name: 5-a-day Veg Tagine
description: Use this vegetable tagine as a base to play around with your cooking. You can swap out the vegetables depending on what you have in your fridge, butternut works super well instead of sweet potato, for instance, and if you’re looking for a bit of added spice or flavour, try stirring in some harissa, too. It’s easy to see why this Moroccan dish has taken over the world. This is one of our favourite Middle Eastern-inspired recipes.
instructions: Finely slice the red onions. Heat a half of the oil in a large saucepan or casserole dish set over a medium heat. Scrape in the onions with some seasoning. Cook for 8-10 mins, stirring occasionally until soft.
Meanwhile, peel the carrots and sweet potatoes and cut into medium 3cm-sized chunks. Finely chop the garlic cloves.

Add the carrot, sweet potato and garlic to the onion along with the remaining oil. Cook, stirring for a couple of minutes then stir in the tomato purée, smoked paprika, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon. Cook, stirring for 2 mins more.

Tip in the plum tomatoes and the chickpeas along with their water, then refill one of the tins with water and pour that in, too. Bring everything up to the boil, using the back of your spoon to break up the tomatoes a little.
Finely chop the preserved lemons, and add half to the pan. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer away for 20-25 mins until the sweet potato is tender whilst holding its shape.
Meanwhile, scrape the remaining preserved lemon into a small bowl. Stir in the yoghurt, then season with salt, pepper and lemon juice to taste.

Roughly chop all the parsley (stalks and all), along with the prunes or dried apricots. Stir the fruit and most of the parsley through the tagine then season to taste, adding any remaining lemon juice.
Serve the tagine with couscous or flatbreads, the preserved lemon yoghurt spooned over, along with the remaining parsley and toasted flaked almonds, if you like.

name: 6-Ingredient Carrot & Sage Risotto
description: A warming six-ingredient risotto that makes the most of seasonal veg. Carrots a nice, natural sweetness to this recipe.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the carrots into coins, finely slice the garlic and roughly chop ½ of the sage.

Grab ¼ of the carrot slices and add to a large frying pan with a good glug of olive oil. Set over a high heat and cook, stirring regularly, until the carrots start to caramelise and turn crispy. Once crisp, remove from the pan and set aside on kitchen paper. Drop in a handful of the remaining whole sage leaves and crisp for 1 min.

Return the pan to the heat and add the remaining carrots, the garlic and chopped sage to the pan with a little more oil, plenty of salt and a few cracks of pepper. Sauté for 2-3 mins then add a ladle full of stock and cover with a lid. Cook until very tender (8-9 mins) and then add two-thirds of the carrots to a blender. Blend on high until smooth. If it’s a little thick, add a splash of stock.

Bring your stock to a boil and chuck the rice in for 4 mins. Scoop out the rice and add to the pan with the remaining carrots. Now, cook the risotto as you normally would, over a medium heat, stirring constantly, adding stock now and then when the pan dries up, until the rice is tender and has a creamy texture.
Finish the risotto with the carrot purée and lots of grated Parmesan cheese. Divide between warm bowls and top with the crispy carrots, more parmesan and the crispy sage leaves.
Get stuck in.

name: 6-Ingredient Tomato Gnocchi
description: Ben's back with a banger. Gnocchi coated in a rich tomato sauce. Dinner on the table in just 15 minutes, this one's a goodie.
instructions: Finely slice garlic and shallots.
Add a good glug of olive oil to a pan, add shallots and cook until soft and translucent.
Get your gnocchi into a pot of salted boiling water.

Add garlic and chilli flakes to your pan with the soft, sliced shallots. Before the garlic starts to brown, add your tomato purée and give it a good mix. Cook until the tomato purée starts to caramelise.
Add the very starchy gnocchi water to your tomatey pan and keep adding gnocchi water until you get a thick starchy sauce.
When the gnocchi is al dente (this should take about 2 mins), add it to the tomatoey pan. Get a fork and mix the gnocchi thoroughly to make sure the gnocchi doesn't stick together.
Tear the basil onto your gnocchi. Season with salt and pepper. Tuck in.

name: Absinthe Hot Chocolate
description: This is a seriously indulgent hard hot chocolate to keep you warm this winter. Super creamy and spiked with absinthe, it’s ideal for getting that going out feeling when staying in.
instructions: Roughly break up the chocolate into small 2-3cm pieces. Place the chocolate in a medium metal bowl and set aside.
Heat the cream and milk in a medium saucepan set over a low-medium heat until the mixture just starts to bubble at the sides (not boiling but getting there).
Slowly pour the hot cream over the chocolate and leave to sit for 1–2 mins until the chocolate starts to melt. Sprinkle in the salt and whisk gently to bring the mixture together.
Pour the mixture back into the saucepan, turn the heat back up to low-medium and add the absinthe. Stir over the heat for a minute or two before serving hot.

name: Absolutely Smashing Salmon & Seasame Smash
description: Hot smoked salmon, avocado and edamame smashed through a sesame and ginger yoghurt dressing, piled onto toast with a hit of sriracha. Ready in 15 mins.
instructions: Peel and grate the ginger into a large bowl. Add the Greek yoghurt, sesame oil, sesame seeds, rice vinegar and sugar with a pinch of salt, then mix until smooth and glossy.

Flake the hot smoked salmon into the dressing, discarding any skin. Scoop out the avocado flesh, dice the cucumber and finely slice the spring onion. Squeeze the pickled ginger dry and finely chop. Add everything to the bowl along with the edamame, then smash together with a fork, leaving some texture. Taste and season with a little more salt if it needs it.
Toast the sourdough. Pile the smash onto the toast, drizzle each slice with a tsp of the sriracha and scatter over the crispy fried onions.

name: Adana Meatballs, Ezme Salad & Flatbreads
description: Juicy, spiced lamb meatballs, zingy Ezme salad and fluffy flatbreads — this is your new favourite handheld feast. Don’t forget the yoghurt swipe.
instructions: Finely chop one of the roasted red peppers. Peel and grate the garlic. Add both to a bowl with the lamb mince, ground cumin, smoked paprika, chilli flakes, a good pinch of salt and plenty of black pepper. Mix everything together with your hands, then shape into small sausage-shaped meatballs.

Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a frying pan set over a medium-high heat. Fry the meatballs for 8–10 mins, turning now and then, until browned all over and cooked through. Drizzle in the pomegranate molasses and toss everything to coat.

Meanwhile, finely chop the second roasted red pepper, the tomatoes and the red onion. Chuck it all into a bowl with the pomegranate molasses, a drizzle of olive oil, the juice of half a lemon and a pinch of salt. Mix well and set aside.
Warm your flatbreads in a dry pan or directly over the flame if you’ve got gas.
To serve, spoon a smear of yoghurt onto each plate and sprinkle with sumac. Add the meatballs, pile on the Ezme salad and scatter over the parsley. Use the warm flatbreads to scoop everything up.

name: Aglio E Olio
description: We have perfected the aglio e olio. Lemon is key. Creating an emulsion with the olive oil & the pasta water makes the most delicious pasta you'll ever eat.
instructions: Boil a pan of water, salt it generously and then add your spaghetti.
Get a frying pan and heat the olive oil. Finely slice your garlic and add to the pan with your chilli flakes. It is important to not let your garlic burn so keep stirring it on a low heat.

Once the pasta is al dente, reserve a mug of the starchy pasta water and add a little into the garlic pan along with a pinch of salt. Stir together and lightly simmer. This is when the sauce will start coming together.

Chop your parsley (saving some for garnish) and drain the pasta. Add them both into the frying pan along with the juice from a lemon. Salt the dish and start tossing it all together to create an emulsion between the pasta water and olive oil. Add more of the water if the pasta looks dry.

Once everything is mixed in and the pasta is thick and almost creamy (from the pasta water), remove from the heat. Season and serve it up with extra chopped parsley on top as a garnish. Drizzle over some more olive oil. Enjoy!

name: Aglio E Olio Chickpeas
description: 5 ingredients. 20 minutes. A fresh, protein-packed dish.
instructions: Finely slice your garlic.
Drain your chickpeas (save the chickpea water).
Add the olive oil to a pan. Then add your garlic and your chilli flakes. Fry on low until the garlic is translucent (but not brown). Pour in some chickpea water to halt the frying.
Add your drained chickpeas to the pan. Stir them through, and then add the chickpea water. You want the liquid water to just cover the chickpeas, so if you need to add more water, do that.

Bubble the sauce down on a medium heat until the chickpea water and the oil have emulsified to form a thick sauce (about 10 mins). If the sauce isn't thickening, blend a few tbsp of the chickpeas with a splash of water and return into the dish until thickened.
Once everything has come together, add a large handful of finely chopped parsley, and the juice of a lemon. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve onto plates. Top with more parsley and olive oil. Enjoy.

name: Aglio, Olio Tortellini Soup
description: A simple twist on the italian classic pasta dish. This one-pot tortellini soup is pure comfort and done in 15.
instructions: Add the chopped garlic and olive oil to a medium saucepan. Set over a medium heat and let the garlic sizzle gently for 2–3 mins, stirring occasionally to stop it catching.
Stir in half of the chilli flakes, then pour in the stock and drop in the frozen spinach. Whack the heat up to high, pop a lid on and bring to the boil. Zest your lemon and set aside.
Once boiling, remove the lid and add the tortellini. Cook following pack instructions, then take off the heat. Taste the broth and season with salt and a good squeeze of lemon juice.
Ladle the soup into bowls. Sprinkle over the remaining chilli flakes if you want more of a kick, then top with some lemon zest to taste and grated Parmesan.

name: Aguachile Prawn Salad
description: This is by no means authentic, it is inspired by the mighty Aguachile. Translating to "chile water", this recipe is packed full of heat and citrus bite. B x
instructions: First up, the prawns. Chuck them in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Coat with a glug of oil.
Preheat a frying pan over a high heat. Add the prawns and cook for 2 mins on each side until bright pink and just cooked through. Pop them in a bowl and set aside.
Give your coriander a good wash, save a handful of the leaves and chuck the rest into a blender. Add the juice of 3 limes.
Now roughly chop 2 of the jalapeños, the spring onions, the garlic clove and ½ of the cucumber. Bang it all into the blender with the lime and coriander.
Blend the lot with a big pinch of salt. If you need a bit more lime juice or water to get things moving, go for it. You should have a bright green, tangy, spicy dressing.
Now slice up the rest of the jalapeño and cucumber, dice the courgette, tomatoes and avocado. Quarter the tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion.
Pop all the veg and cooked prawns in a big mixing bowl, pour over your green sauce, a small glug of olive oil and give it a good mix. Scoop up with tortilla chips or anything you like. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Caprese Chicken
description: Taking one of our favourite Italian salads and literally shoving it inside a chicken breast. Apologies to any Italian followers out there but this recipe is here to stay.
instructions: Start by making the cherry tomatoes base. Tip the cherry tomatoes into an air fryer tray in a single layer. Drizzle with the balsamic vinegar and a glug of olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and scatter over a few basil leaves.

For the chicken, hasselback the chicken breasts by cutting slits into the chicken breasts about 1cm apart but taking care not to cut all the way through – about 75% of the way down is what you should aim for. Coat the chicken breasts in paprika. Slice the tomatoes and halve the slices. Do the same with the mozzarella. Stuff the chicken breasts with the tomatoes, mozzarella and basil slices.

Add the chicken to the air fryer tray, on top of the cherry tomatoes. Transfer to the air fryer to cook for 20 mins at 180°C. If cooking for a large group or family, you can use more chicken or even cook it in the oven for 30-35 mins at 180°C.
Serve with salad and bread. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Chicken Parm & Spaghetti
description: A classic Italian-American recipe that's made for the air fryer. High in protein, and highly satisfying.
keywords: Air Fryer Chicken Parm & Spaghetti recipe
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil.
Peel and thinly slice the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a wide saucepan over a medium heat, then add the garlic and cook for 1–2 mins until just golden.
Tip in the chopped tomatoes, season well and let the sauce gently simmer while you prep the chicken.
Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of baking paper and bash them to about 1cm thick.

Set up a breading station with three plates — one with the flour, one with the beaten egg and one with the breadcrumbs. Season the chicken on both sides with salt and pepper. Dip each piece in the flour, then the egg, then the panko.
Cook the spaghetti following pack instructions, reserving a splash of pasta water before draining.
Spray the chicken with some oil spray on each side. Transfer the breaded chicken to an air fryer basket and cook at 200°C for 8 mins. Flip and cook for another 8 mins until golden and cooked through.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the tomato sauce with half the parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Toss until the sauce clings to the pasta.
Divide the saucy spaghetti between two plates. Slice the crispy chicken and lay it on top. Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan and a big dollop of cottage cheese.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Tikka Enchiladas with Mint Yoghurt & Mango Chutney
description: These enchiladas are a delicious fusion of Indian and Mexican cuisines, requiring minimal washing up but producing maximum flavour!
keywords: Air Fryer Chicken Tikka Enchiladas recipe
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized chunks, crush the garlic and slice the lemon in half. Combine the chicken, yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic, half of the tomato purée, and half of the curry powder in a large bowl. You can leave this to marinate in the fridge if you have time, or want to prep ahead.

Heat the air fryer to 200°C. Chop the onion into chunks and transfer to the air-fryer basket along with the marinated chicken. Cook for 12-14 mins until the chicken is cooked through and charred around the edges.
Stir in the passata and cream, along with the remaining tomato purée and curry powder. Season, then cook for another few minutes until the sauce is hot and thickened.

Lower the air fryer temperature to 180°C. Microwave each wrap, then line up one-quarter of the chicken mix and a tenth of the cheese horizontally along the centre of each wrap, leaving around 2½cm either end. Fold the wrap in on each side (not essential, but it keeps them a bit more contained!), then roll up and place back into the air fryer without the basket. Use a spatula to smother the remaining bits of sauce on top of the wraps, then top with the remaining cheese. Cook in the air fryer for around 8 mins or until golden and bubbly.
Meanwhile, prepare the mint yoghurt by combining all the ingredients in a ramekin.
To serve, drizzle the enchiladas with mint yoghurt and mango chutney, then scatter some coriander on top.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Tikka with Spiced Rice
description: If you're still a bit dubious about air fryers, this might be the one to convert you. Juicy, oniony, and minty, this chicken tikka will have your mouth watering.
instructions: Finely slice the red onions. Add ½ of the sliced onions to a bowl with the juice of ¼ of the lemons and season with salt. Leave to quickly pickle while you prep the rest of the dish. Cut ⅓ of the remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for garnish.

Slice the chicken thighs into three pieces. Add to a bowl with the juice of ½ the remaining lemon, the yoghurt and tikka paste. Season generously with salt and pepper, then mix well. Cover and set aside in the fridge for at least 30 mins.

Meanwhile, make the raita. Halve the cucumber lengthways and scoop out the seeds before finely dicing. Finely chop the mint. Add the yoghurt to a bowl and squeeze in the juice of the remaining lemon. Add the cucumber and mint to the bowl and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Add the rest of the onions to the air fryer, drizzle with a glug of olive oil and top with the chicken pieces, then add another small drizzle of oil. Set the air fryer to 200°C and cook for 14-16 mins until charred and the chicken juices run clear.
Finely slice the green chilli and cut the tomato into wedges. Add the tomatoes to a bowl along with the nigella seeds, then season with salt and pepper.
Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Remove the chicken from the air fryer, then toss the cooked onions with the rice. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the rice between two plates, add the tomatoes, then top with the tikka chicken and pickled onions. Scatter with the green chilli, lemon wedges and more mint, if you like.

name: Air Fryer Chipotle Tomato Tostadas with Feta & Limey Pickles
description: With the weather warming up, this is the perfect al fresco air fryer recipe. Enjoy.
instructions: Finely slice the red onion and radishes, then add to a bowl with the juice of ½ a lime, salt and sugar, if using. Give them a massage with your hands and set aside to turn bright pink.

Get your tortillas into the air fryer and cook them for around 5 mins in 1 min bursts, flattening them out each time so they don't curl up too much. Once crisp, remove them from the air fryer to cool, they will also firm up as they cool.

Halve the avocado, remove the pit and scoop into a processor along with the yoghurt, coriander stalks, and the remaining lime juice. Season generously with salt and pepper then blitz smooth. Finely dice the jalapeño and mix through, removing the seeds if you like it less spicy.
Add the tomatoes to a bowl with the chipotle paste and the olive oil. Season with salt and pepper then pop in the air fryer at 160°C for 20 mins. They should be nicely jammy with charred edges.
Spread the avocado onto the crisp tortilla and top with the roast tomatoes. Crumble over the feta, scatter with coriander and top with the pickles.

name: Air Fryer Crispy Honey Chilli Halloumi
description: We struggle to not eat a whole block of halloumi every week and this crispy honey chilli halloumi is a major reason why.
keywords: Air Fryer Crispy Honey Chilli Halloumi
Air Fryer Crispy Honey Chilli Halloumi recipe
instructions: Lay out three shallow bowls in a line. Tip the flour into one, beat the egg into another and put the breadcrumbs in the third.
Cut the halloumi into even-sized cubes, then coat them first in the flour, then the beaten egg and finally the breadcrumbs.
Brush with vegetable oil (or spray with spray oil) and air fry for 11-12 mins at 200°C.
Meanwhile, combine the honey and sweet chilli in a bowl. When the halloumi is done, brush the warm cheese with the honey chilli sauce mix and top with sesame seeds. Serve.

name: Air Fryer Crispy Sesame Chicken
description: Probably the best and easiest fakeaway recipe you’ll make in your air fryer. Sticky sweet and crispy chicken balls. Even the sauce goes into the air fryer – it’s that simple.
keywords: Air Fryer Crispy Sesame Chicken recipe
instructions: Lay out three shallow bowls in a line. Tip the flour into one, beat the egg into another and put the breadcrumbs in the third.
Roughly chop the chicken into bite size pieces, then coat the chicken in the flour, then dip in the beaten egg and finally the breadcrumbs. Spray with oil and air fry for 14 mins at 200°C.
Meanwhile, mix the sauce ingredients together in a bowl. Slice the spring onions and red chilli, then set aside.
Once the chicken is done, pour the sauce straight into the air fryer basket, shake well so that it coats the chicken, then air fry for 2 mins.
Top with sesame seeds, the sliced spring onions and chillies. Enjoy!

name: Air Fryer Duck Pancakes
description: One of our all time favourite orders in a Chinese restaurant. This is a very non authentic way to make it with very few ingredients.
instructions: Coat the duck in the five-spice and pop half a lime in the cavity. Transfer to the air fryer and cook at 180°C for 1 hr.
After 20 mins of cooking, carefully tip some of the oil from the air fryer basket into a bowl for you to discard safely, brush the duck in some of the oil but don’t over do it.
Once done, allow the cooked duck to rest for 15 mins. Use a knife to cut the meat from the bone, then use two forks to roughly shred it up.
While the duck is resting, steam the pancakes (you can do this in the microwave), slice the spring onions lengthways and cut the cucumber into thin matchsticks.
Serve the pancakes alongside the shredded duck, spring onions, cucumber and hoisin sauce.

name: Air Fryer Gochujang Cod
description: A seriously satisfying dinner with tender cod, fluffy rice, crunchy cucumber salad and a spicy gochujang sauce. It’s fresh, healthy and hits the spot.
instructions: Start with the herb salad. Finely slice the spring onions, separating the whites from the greens. Slice the cucumber into thin half moons. Pick the coriander leaves. In a bowl, mix together the cucumber, coriander and the greens of the spring onions and set aside. (Optional: refresh in iced water to make the salad extra crisp.)

For the sauce, finely slice the garlic and chilli and mince the ginger. Place a small saucepan over a medium heat and melt the butter. Once foaming, add the garlic, ginger, chilli and whites of the spring onions to a small pan. Cook for 4-5 mins, until the garlic begins to brown, then add the sugar and cook for a further minute. Add the gochujang and water and cook for another 2-3 mins until glossy. Season with the juice of ½ the lime and the fish sauce to taste.

For the cod, pat the fillets dry with a paper towel. Rub lightly with vegetable oil and sprinkle over the five spice and a pinch of salt. Pop the cod fillets in the air fryer and cook at 220°C for 5 mins, or until cooked through. You know it’s cooked when you poke a skewer through the thickest part of the fish, without any resistance.
Meanwhile, reheat the cooked rice.

To serve, plate up the rice along one side of each bowl and the cod fillet on the other. Pour the sauce over the cod and place the cucumber salad in a pile over one end of the rice and serve with a wedge of the remaining lime.

name: Air Fryer Lemon & Garlic Chicken Hummus Bowls with Tomato & Mint Salsa
description: Fancy a souvlaki with none of the fuss? Just bung it in the air fryer and you'll have a deliciously Greek-inspired midweek dinner in no time at all.
instructions: Get your chicken into a bowl and squeeze in the juice of ⅔ of the lemons and half the olive oil. Add the oregano and garlic powder then season with salt and pepper. Dice the peppers, then add to the chicken bowl. Cover and set aside in the fridge whilst you get on with everything else.
Finely slice the fennel and add to another bowl. Squeeze in the juice of half a lemon and add the sumac before seasoning with salt and pepper.

Halve the tomatoes and scoop out the seeds, then finely dice. Finely chop the mint and onion, then tip into a bowl along with the tomatoes. Squeeze in the juice of the remaining lemon with a splash of olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Add the marinated peppers to the air fryer, then top with the chicken. Turn the air fryer on to 200°C and cook for 10 mins, then flip the chicken and cook for a further 5 mins, or until the chicken is charred and the juices run clear.
Heat up the flatbreads. You can do this in the air fryer at 160°C for a few minutes.

Dollop a swoosh of hummus into two bowls, then add the fennel salad, chicken and peppers. Spoon over the juicy tomato salsa and a few more mint leaves (plus lemon wedges), if you like. Scoop everything up with your warm flatbreads and enjoy.

name: Air Fryer Moroccan Chicken & Couscous
description: This light but filling meal is one of our go-tos when we're short on time. Spiced chicken with a sweet couscous salad - you can’t really go wrong.
keywords: Air Fryer Moroccan Chicken & Couscous recipe
instructions: Heat the air fryer to 200°C. Put the chicken, 1 tbsp oil, garlic purée, spices and onion granules into a bowl. Squeeze in the lemon juice, season, then mix well. Transfer everything to the air fryer and cook for 14-18 mins.
Meanwhile, put the couscous, turmeric and hot stock in a heatproof bowl. Stir, then cover with cling film and set aside while the chicken is cooking.
Chop the sun dried tomatoes, cucumber and basil leaves, then set aside.
When the chicken is done, add the remaining ingredients to the couscous, fluff-up the grains with a fork, slice the chicken and serve with a salad of your choice.

name: Air Fryer Pollo Pesto Gnocchi
description: An easy, minimal fuss, minimal clean-up dish that the whole family will love! The perfect weeknight dinner after a busy day. You can make it a 15 min-din by using pre-cooked chicken pieces, too.
keywords: Air Fryer Pollo Pesto Gnocchi recipe
instructions: Dice the chicken breast, then season it with salt, pepper and the mixed herbs. Wrap it in foil and air fry at 180°C for 15 mins, then set aside.⁣
Meanwhile, halve the cherry tomatoes and dice the red onion. Combine all the sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside.
Tip the cooked chicken into the sauce bowl and set aside. Put the gnocchi into the air fryer, spray with the olive oil, then cook for around 12 mins at 190°C until crispy.

Once the gnocchi is crispy, add the onion, tomatoes, chicken and sauce to the air fryer with the gnocchi. Roughly mix together, then top with the cheese and pine nuts and return to the air fryer for another 5 mins until bubbly.⁣

name: Air Fryer Prawn & Sesame Toast
description: We're obsessed with this simple air fryer prawn toast recipe. An excellent fakeaway recipe.
keywords: Air Fryer Prawn & Sesame Toast recipe
instructions: Put the prawns into a bowl, then mash them with a fork. Alternatively, mash the prawns in a food processor (using a fork can be a little awkward). Grate the garlic and ginger.

Add the sesame oil, garlic and ginger to the mashed prawns. Mix well. Divide the mixture equally between the bread slices, then spread it perfectly flat with a knife. Make sure the whole slice is covered.
Cut each piece of bread into four triangles, so that you have 16 triangles in total.

Beat the egg in a small bowl. Carefully dip each triangle into the beaten egg, plain-side down. You’re only coating the bread side, not the prawn side. Transfer the dipped triangles to a plate, egg-side up and scatter with sesame seeds.
Spray each triangle, egg-side up, with oil spray and stick in the air fryer for 8 mins at 200°C.
Serve with the sweet chilli sauce on the side, for dipping. Enjoy every triangle… so so good.

name: Air Fryer Roast Potatoes Recipe
description: Discover the ultimate way to enjoy crispy, golden-brown potatoes with our air fryer roast potatoes recipe. Perfect for a Sunday dinner or as a delightful side for any meal, this recipe leverages the power of the air fryer to deliver perfectly roasted potatoes with minimal oil. Using white potatoes or red potatoes, this method ensures a satisfying crunch on the outside while keeping the inside tender and fluffy. Whether you’re pairing these with roast chicken or serving them alongside steak, the air fryer’s convection cooking mimics traditional oven roasting but with less time and fuss. Ideal for busy home cooks looking to enhance their side dishes, our recipe transforms humble potatoes into a gourmet treat, perfect for Christmas dinner or a regular weeknight meal. Enjoy these crispy fries without the extra calories from deep-frying!
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into chunky roast potato shapes. Transfer to a pan of cold water with a big pinch of salt. Put on the lid, bring to the boil and simmer for 7 mins.
Drain well in a colander, tossing well to rough up the edges. At this stage you could spread them out on a baking tray to cool, then chill for up to 24 hrs until needed.
Remove the needles from the rosemary and very finely chop. Scrape into a bowl with the flaky sea salt and finely grate in the zest from the lemon.
When ready to cook, tip the potatoes into a bowl and spoon in 3 tbsp of the fat or oil, gently tossing to coat. Sprinkle some of the rosemary salt on top and gently toss.

Fit the air fryer basket with a tray, or make your own with foil. Tip the potatoes onto the tray, spreading them out so they’re as close to a single layer as possible. Drizzle with the remaining 2 tbsp fat or oil and sprinkle with more rosemary salt.
Heat the air fryer to 200°C and put the basket full of potatoes in. Set the timer to 45 mins. After 20 mins or so, toss the potatoes really well, and roast until super crunchy and crisp.
Tip into a bowl and sprinkle with a bit of the remaining rosemary salt, if you like.

name: Air Fryer Salmon Tacos with Mango Chipotle Glaze
description: An easy air fryer recipe that you can make in just 20 minutes. Glazing your salmon fillets in a sweet and spicy marinade makes all the difference.
keywords: Air Fryer Salmon Tacos With Mango Chipotle Glaze
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to high (240°C).

Dice the salmon into medium-sized cubes (about 3 per fillet). Season the salmon with salt and pop into a parchment lined pan or a tray. Mix together the chutney and the chipotle paste and tip over the salmon. Pop into the airfryer for 6-8 mins or until fully cooked, spooning any extra marinade over the fish as it cooks.

Thinly slice the cabbage and red onion and chuck into a bowl. Dress with a little salt and lime juice and toss through chopped dill. Thinly slice the scotch bonnet, season with salt and squeeze a little lime juice over the top.
Heat the tacos according to the package instructions.
Pull the fish out of the oven, it should be cooked and glazed in the spicy, smoky mango chipotle mix. (Flake it into smaller pieces, if you like.)
Build your tacos starting with the shells, topped with sour cream, some fish, a handful of slaw, the chillies and chopped spring onion and radishes. Get stuck in.

name: Air Fryer Sesame Orange Broccoli & Tofu Bowl
description: This healthy air fryer recipe is inspired by a Chinese takeaway classic. It's quick, flavourful, and perfect for a weeknight meal.
keywords: Air Fryer Sesame Orange Broccoli & Tofu Bowl
Air Fryer Sesame Orange Broccoli & Tofu Bowl recipe
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Prepare the broccoli by cutting it into florets. Place in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Let stand for 3 minutes, then drain and allow to steam dry.
Prepare the tofu by patting it dry and breaking it into 2 cm pieces. Toss with 2 tbsp cornflour, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Add to the air fryer and cook at 200°C for 10 minutes, turning halfway.
Toss the broccoli with ½ tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Remove the tofu from the air fryer and add the broccoli. Place the tofu back on top and cook for another 5 minutes until golden and tender.

Meanwhile, mix 1 tbsp cornflour with 4 tbsp water in a small saucepan. Add the juice of the orange, soy sauce, honey, garlic powder, chilli flakes, and rice vinegar. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until bubbling and slightly thickened (about 3 minutes). Remove from the heat.
Serve the rice or noodles topped with the tofu and broccoli. Garnish with spring onions, the zest of ¼ of the orange, and sesame seeds.

name: Air Fryer Smoky Chicken & Chorizo
description: Here's a lovely batch recipe that you can turn into three more equally as lovely recipes. Best of all, you can make it in your air fryer.
instructions: Remove the bones from the chicken thighs. Pat the chicken skin dry with kitchen paper, then drizzle with half the olive oil and season generously with salt.
Pop the chicken into the air fryer skin-side down and cook for 6 mins at 200ºC. Flip the chicken over and cook for 10 mins, then remove.

Meanwhile, cut the tomatoes and red onion into wedges and finely chop the rosemary. Add the tomatoes, onions, chorizo, olives, rosemary and paprika to the air fryer along with the remaining olive oil, then season with salt and pepper. Turn the air fryer on to 180ºC and cook for 15 mins, making sure the chorizo is on top and turning it over halfway.
Warm through the chicken for the last few minutes if eating immediately, or pop it all into containers to put in the fridge.

name: Air Fryer Sriracha & Honey Halloumi Chicken
description: Stuck for meal inspiration? Try this easy, quick chicken dish that will hit the spot every time giving you a Nando’s fakeaway feel.
keywords: Airfryer Sriracha & Honey Halloumi Chicken recipe
instructions: Use a sharp knife to cut 3 deep slits into each of the chicken breasts, making sure not to slice all the way through. Rub the Cajun seasoning all over the chicken. Slice the halloumi into 1cm thick slices. Stuff the slits in the chicken breast with halloumi.
Put the sriracha and honey into a bowl and mix well. Brush on top of the chicken breasts.

Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 13-14 mins or until the chicken is cooked through (you may need an extra few mins if using large chicken breasts). If you don’t want your halloumi too dark or crispy, turn the halloumi halfway through the cooking time and baste.
Meanwhile, put the dipping sauce ingredients into a small bowl. Mix well.
Serve the chicken with the dipping sauce, a side salad and rice for a delicious yet simple dinner.

name: Air Fryer Steak, Crispy Potatoes & Slaw with Piri Piri Dressing
description: You may have thought that air fryer steak couldn't be done, but we're here to tell you that it absolutely can. Thank us later.
instructions: Take the steak out of the fridge and let it come up to room temp.

Dice ½ of the peppers and all of the red onion. Add to a bowl with oil, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Mix well and air fry at 180°C for 5-10 mins. In the meantime, peel and halve the garlic and remove the stem and seeds from the chillies. Add into the tray with the peppers, mix and then air fry for another 10 mins. Remove from the air fryer and blend smooth with ½ the lemon juice and water. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice the rest of the red pepper and set aside in a separate bowl.
Finely chop the rosemary and halve the potatoes. Add to a bowl with the sliced peppers along with the oil, salt and pepper. Cook at 200°C for 15 mins, mixing halfway.
Pat the steak dry, then rub it with the rest of the oil, salt and pepper. Pop on top of the potatoes and cook for 8-10 more mins, depending on the thickness of the steak.

Now you can get on with the slaw. Finely chop the parsley. Finely slice the cabbage and remaining red onion, mix in a bowl with the rest of the lemon juice, mustard, parsley and mayo. Season with salt and pepper.
Once the steak is cooked, remove from the air fryer and let it rest for at least 5 mins before slicing. Get the potatoes and slaw into bowls, then top with the steak and piri piri dressing.

name: Air Fryer Sticky Salmon & Edamame Rice Bowl
description: Sweet, sticky salmon cubes crisped in the air fryer, served over rice with crunchy cucumber salad and a zingy sriracha yoghurt drizzle. Easy, satisfying, big on flavour.
keywords: air fryer sticky salmon and rice
instructions: Whisk together the Dijon mustard and honey in a bowl with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Cut the salmon into 3–4cm chunks and toss them through the glaze until coated.

Spray the rack of your air fryer with non-stick spray. Add the salmon chunks and cook at 200°C for 6 mins until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside, then chuck in the edamame and cook for 2 mins until piping hot.

Thinly slice the cucumber, spring onions and avocado. Toss the cucumber with the white parts of the spring onions (reserving the greens to garnish), rice vinegar and a third of the sriracha. Set aside.
In a small bowl, loosen the Greek yoghurt with the remaining sriracha and water until you’ve got a drizzling consistency.

Heat the sticky rice according to packet instructions. To serve, spoon the sticky rice into bowls and top with the sticky salmon, cucumber salad and sliced avocado. Drizzle over the yoghurt sauce and scatter over the green parts of the spring onion.

name: Air Fryer Tandoori Chicken Skewers & Rice
description: If you’re a fan of fakeaways then you will love these air fryer tandoori chicken skewers and rice. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner, this dish promises to satisfy your cravings with minimal effort.
keywords: Airfryer Tandoori Chicken Skewers & Rice recipe
instructions: Chop the chicken into chunks. Put all of the spices, yoghurt, tomato purée, garlic and ginger into a bowl. Squeeze in the lemon juice and add a dash of red food colouring, if you like. Add the chicken and coat well.
Thread the chicken chunks onto skewers and cook them in the air fryer at 200°C for 17 mins.
Meanwhile, put the fat-free yoghurt, juice of both limes, the mint and a pinch of salt and pepper into a blender. Whizz until smooth.
Serve the chicken skewers with the yoghurt dip and flatbreads or rice.

name: Air-Fryer Negima Yakitori
description: We've used the air fryer to create a quick and easy version of nagima yakitori. It's foolproof.
instructions: Cut your spring onions and chicken thighs into evenly-sized 2cm pieces.
Thread the chicken and spring onion pieces tightly onto skewers, alternating between them. Season with salt and white pepper and set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and mirin. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook for around 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Toss the Padrón peppers with olive oil and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Add the skewers, brush with some glaze, and drizzle with a little olive oil. Cook for 9-10 minutes, brushing with more glaze halfway through.
Add the Padron peppers to the air fryer, brush the chicken again with glaze, and cook for another 5-6 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the peppers are charred.
Cook the rice according to package instructions, adding the edamame 5 minutes before the end of the cooking time.
Plate up the edamame rice, then top with the skewers and Padron peppers. Dust with shichimi togarashi, if using.

name: Aish Baladi (Egyptian Flatbread)
description: These soft and nutty flatbreads are a delicious addition to any meal. We love stuffing them with freshly fried falafel.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the yeast and water, set aside until foamy, 5-10 mins. Add the wholemeal flour into the yeast mixture and mix together until combined. Cover and set aside for 30 mins.

Then, stir in the salt, olive oil and the strong white bread flour into the yeast mixture, using your hands, mix together until a dough forms. Lightly flour a clean surface with wholemeal flour and knead until no longer sticky and it becomes smooth and elastic, 8-10 mins. Add more flour to the surface if it’s sticking too much. Form the dough into a ball and place in a greased bowl. Cover and proof until doubled in size, 45 mins-1.5 hours.

Punch the dough down and divide into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and place onto a baking tray that has been lightly dusted with more wholemeal flour. Cover with a damp tea towel and leave the dough to rest for 15 mins.

Take 1 ball of dough at a time and place on a lightly dusted surface. Lightly dust the dough with more wholemeal flour and roll the dough out using a rolling pin to 1cm thick- the flatbread should be roughly the size of your hand. Lightly dust parchment paper with wholemeal flour and place the rolled out dough onto it covering with a damp tea towel, continue rolling the rest of the dough out. Leave to proof until slightly puffed, around 20-30 mins.
Meanwhile, place a large cast iron skillet or baking stone into the oven. If you don’t have those, a baking tray works. Pre-heat it to fan grill 230°C – you need it piping hot.

Once the skillet/stone/tray has preheated for at least 30 mins, add 1 or 2 flatbreads onto your hot surface and bake until the bread balloons, 2-4 mins. Then transfer into a clean tea towel. Continue this process until all the flatbreads are cooked.

name: Al Pastor Tacos
description: Tender, juicy pork meat marinated in pineapple juice, Mexican chillies and achiote. It’s the most iconic taco recipe for a reason.
instructions: Remove the stem and seeds from the guajillo chillies then place in a bowl. Cover with hot water and leave for 10 mins to rehydrate.
Drain the guajillo chillies and place them in a high-speed blender. Add the rest of the adobo ingredients and blitz until smooth.

Thinly slice the pork shoulder and place it in a large bowl. Pour over the adobo and, wearing plastic gloves, massage the mixture into the meat, making sure it’s really well coated. Leave to marinate for at least an hour.

Meanwhile, make the salsa verde: peel the onion and garlic cloves and add them to a saucepan along with the fresh tomatillos. Cover them with water. Bring to a boil over a medium heat then lower the heat and simmer for 10 mins. While the mixture simmers, roughly chop the coriander.

Strain the vegetables from the water (don’t discard the water yet) and transfer them to a blender, adding the coriander, salt and pinch of caster sugar. Blend until smooth. If the salsa is too thick, add a splash of water until it’s the desired consistency. Cover and set aside until ready to serve.
For the garnish, chop the pineapple into chunks, finely chop the onion and fresh coriander and cut the lime into wedges. Add to small bowls or a plate, keeping the ingredients separate.

When the pork has marinated, heat the oil in a frying pan set over a medium heat. Add the pork slices and fry them for around 3 mins on each side (don't overcrowd the pan – do it in batches if necessary) until crispy at the edges. Transfer the pork to a plate to rest while you heat the tortillas.

Wipe out the steak pan (make sure it's really dry) then set it over a medium-high heat. Add the corn tortillas, one at a time, and heat for 15-30 secs on each side. Wrap them in a tea towel to keep warm.
Chop the pork into small pieces and transfer to a serving plate.
Place everything on the table and let everyone help themselves to build their own steak tacos!

name: Alaska Smoked Salmon Rösti
description: The crispiest röstis topped with delicious smoked salmon, a perfectly poached egg and finely chopped chives. An elegant dish.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and squeeze out as much liquid as possible to make them nice and dry for frying. We used a tea towel to squeeze out the juice, but you can use anything you like.
Place the dry potato gratings into a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Dice your shallots and add them to the bowl along with your horseradish and a drizzle of olive oil.
Toss this all together, then take a handful of the grated potato and form a thin potato patty. Repeat until you have run out of the mixture.
Heat a large glug of oil in a pan (enough to cover the base) and when it's hot, drop in your röstis and let them fry until golden brown and crispy on either side.

Meanwhile, poach an egg. For the perfect egg, boil a pan of water and add your cider vinegar to it. With a fork or whisk, create a whirlpool of water and crack the egg into the edge (not the centre). With your fork fold the white over the yolk and the egg should form a nice little ball. Leave it for 3 minutes then remove. If the white still looks wobbly continue to cook for 30 seconds, and if it's firm remove.
Time to plate up! Pile up four röstis onto a plate along with your delicious salmon and poached egg on top.
Chop up some chives and scatter over with a season of salt and pepper. Repeat for the whole MOB then tuck in!

name: Aligot with Crispy Chicken Thighs
