Ladle the soup into bowls. Break the cheddar crisp into pieces and scatter over the top, then add a dollop of soured cream and the coriander leaves.

name: Chilli Crisp Tomatoes
description: This chilli crisp tomato salad is perfect for meal prep. Combine it with your choice of protein, carb and topping to create your perfect meal-prep dish.
instructions: Trim and thinly slice the spring onions, then chop the tomatoes into bite-sized chunks.
Put the chilli oil into a large bowl and stir through the rice vinegar. Season with salt, then add the tomatoes and spring onion. Toss well.
If batch cooking for the week, transfer the salad to a container and store in the fridge until ready to eat.

name: Chilli Garlic Prawn Rice Bowl With Cucumber Salad
description: Punchy sriracha prawns, crisp pickled cucumber, and sticky rice. A straight-up weeknight win.
keywords: Chilli Garlic Prawn Rice Bowl With Cucumber Salad
Chilli Garlic Prawn Rice Bowl With Cucumber Salad recipe
instructions: Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water 2–3 times until the water runs clear. Tip into a lidded saucepan with the water and a pinch of salt. Set it over a medium heat. Once simmering, cover with a lid, reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 mins. Remove from the heat and leave covered for 10 mins. Fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile, finely slice the cucumber (use a mandoline if you have one) and add to a bowl with the rice vinegar, soy sauce and a pinch of salt. Mix well and set aside to lightly pickle.
Mince the garlic. Thinly slice the red chilli. Trim and finely slice the spring onion, keeping the whites and greens separate.
Place a frying pan over a medium heat and melt the butter. Add the garlic, spring onion whites and red chilli, then cook for 3 mins until softened and fragrant.

Add the prawns and cook for 90 seconds on each side until just pink. Stir through the sugar and sriracha, then toss for 2 more mins until thick and glossy. Turn off the heat and squeeze in the juice of one lime. Season to taste with salt.
Divide the rice between bowls. Top with the pickled cucumber and prawns. Finish with the spring onion greens, chopped coriander and lime wedges.

name: Chilli Herb Omelette With Salmon & Crème Fraîche
description: We've turned the humble omelette into a swish, finessed brunch recipe and impress someone special. Easy does it.
keywords: Chilli Herb Omelette With Salmon & Crème Fraîche
instructions: Begin by finely chopping the herbs. Add these to a bowl along with a good pinch of chilli flakes. Crack in the eggs and whisk everything together.
Set a non-stick pan over a medium heat and add the butter. When the butter begins to foam pour in the eggs and begin to cook.
With a spatula, gently move the cooked edges of the omelette towards the middle of the pan, then tilt the pan so the uncooked egg takes its place.
When the omelette is almost cooked, season with salt and pepper and fold in half.
Transfer to a plate then top with a few slices of smoked salmon, the crème fraîche and a wedge of lemon. Season with black pepper and garnish with some herbs.

name: Chilli Oil Pasta
description: I’ve combined my two favourite loves (Mama Yu’s Chilli Oil and pasta) to create this dish and you’re gonna become addicted to it. Picture creamy chilli oil pasta that’s sweet, spicy and a little tangy with a hint of Sichuan peppercorns, topped with a coriander panko mix.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook until al dente. Drain the cooked pasta, reserving some of the starchy cooking water.
Meanwhile, mince the shallot and garlic. Grate the Parmesan, and then set it aside.
Tip the Sichuan peppercorns into a small frying pan and toast over a low-medium heat for a few mins until fragrant and starting to smoke. Remove from the heat and grind in a pestle and mortar.

Add the butter to the same pan and, once melted, add the minced garlic and shallot. Fry until softened. Add the chilli oil and fry for 2 mins. Add the ground Sichuan peppercorns, tomato purée, double cream, the juice of both limes, the honey and soy sauce. Mix well until the sauce starts to thicken.

Roughly chop the coriander and add three-quarters of it to the sauce along with 3/4 of the grated Parmesan. Stir well. Add the pasta and a ladle of starchy water, mixing until glossy. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the olive oil to a separate pan set over a low-medium heat, then tip in the panko and fry until golden. Remove from the heat and add the remaining coriander and parmesan.
Top your pasta with coriander panko and enjoy.

name: Chilli Oil Udon
description: This is one of the quickest noodle recipes out there. The only cooking is boiling the noodles. Make the sauce in the bowl you eat from, using scorching oil to bring the sauce together.
instructions: Finely dice the garlic and the tip of the spring onion. Crush the Sichuan peppercorns in a pestle and mortar. Add the crushed peppercorns to a serving bowl along with the chilli powder, sesame seeds, garlic and spring onion.

Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over a high heat for around 3 mins until smoking. Pour the hot oil over the ingredients in the serving bowl and give it a stir. Add the light soy, dark soy, oyster sauce, sugar and MSG and stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Slice the cucumber diagonally into about four slices. Lay each segment flat on the chopping board and slice into thin strips. Roughly chop a handful of coriander into 1cm pieces, stalks and all.

Bring a pot of water to the boil. Add the noodles when the water is boiling and cook following pack instructions. Gently loosen the noodles while cooking. Drain the noodles with a colander and add directly to the serving bowl.

Give it a good mix, making sure to get all the sauce on the bottom to coat the noodles. Add the cucumber, dark vinegar, and coriander and give it one more thorough mix. Give the noodles a big slurp and enjoy!

name: Chilli Orange Roasted Feta & Fennel Grain Bowl
description: A vibrant and flavourful grain bowl with roasted feta, pickled fennel, and a citrusy yoghurt dressing. This dish is packed with textures and bold flavours, perfect for a satisfying meal.
keywords: Chilli Orange Roasted Feta & Fennel Grain Bowl
Chilli Orange Roasted Feta & Fennel Grain Bowl recipe
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C fan.
Tear your feta into 2cm-sized chunks. Thinly slice the red chilli, zest half the orange and segment the whole. Thinly slice the fennel and pick the leaves from the mint.
Place the feta on an oiled baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, and roast for 10-15 minutes until golden.
Now for the dressing. In a bowl, combine the shallots, orange segments, chilli, and sherry vinegar. Season with salt and let sit to pickle.
In another bowl, toss the pecans, mint leaves, cooked grains, lentils, and fennel with half the orange dressing.
In a small bowl, mix the yoghurt with the orange zest, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Stir and set aside.
Stir the cumin seeds and honey into the remaining orange dressing. Once the feta is golden, pour this dressing over the feta and return to the oven for another 10-15 minutes until caramelised.
Divide the grain mixture into serving boxes and top with the chilli orange roasted feta. Finish with a dollop of orange yoghurt. Refrigerate until needed—no need to reheat before serving.

name: Chilli Pan Con Tomate
description: Juicy, ripe tomatoes bundled over a perfectly toasted slice of sourdough spiked with chilli oil and sesame seeds. A little twist on a Spanish staple.
instructions: First, grate the tomatoes. Once grated, tip the tomatoes into a sieve over a bowl. Add a pinch of salt, and leave to sit for 5-10 mins to strain off any excess water.
Meanwhile, toast your bread until golden. Then, tip the grated tomato from the sieve into a clean bowl. Add the zest and juice of your lime, chilli oil and more salt and pepper to season.
To serve, spread the tomato over toast and top with toasted sesame seeds.

name: Chilli Paneer
description: An iconic and must-have Indian takeaway. Soft paneer in a sweet and spicy sauce? It’s incredible and so easy to make.
instructions: Chop up your paneer into cubes and pop it in the freezer for 15 mins.
Combine your plain flour, cornflour, ground cumin, five-spice powder, turmeric, chilli powder and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Toss the paneer in 1 tbsp of oil and then coat in the flour mixture.
Heat up a large saucepan with an inch of oil and shallow-fry the paneer until golden brown, about 2-3 mins per side. Remove to a plate lined with a paper towel and keep aside.
Chop up your onion and pepper into large chunks and finely slice your spring onions.
Pound the Sichuan peppercorns in a mortar and pestle until fine. Then add the ginger, garlic and green chillies and pound to form a thick paste.
In a bowl combine the soy sauce, ketchup, sriracha and vinegar.
Heat up a few glugs of oil in a large pan. Once hot, add in the garlic paste and sauté for 1 min until fragrant. Add the onions and peppers and cook until soft for 3 mins.
Pour in your sauce and bring it to a bubble. Add in the paneer and mix well. Cook for 3 minutes until it’s heated through and slightly softened.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and serve.

name: Chilli Paneer Pasta
description: Paneer tossed in curry powder and a sweet chilli sauce, mixed with gorgeous garlicky pasta.
instructions: Dice the paneer into bite-sized cubes, then transfer to a bowl. Add the oil, turmeric, curry powder and a pinch of salt, then toss well.

Heat a large frying pan over a medium-high heat, add a splash of vegetable oil. Once the oil is shimmering, add the paneer cubes and fry on all sides for a total of 5 mins. Meanwhile, dice the onion, green chillies and peppers. Finely dice the garlic and coriander.
Remove the cooked paneer from the pan and set aside. Add the onion and garlic to the same pan, turn the heat to medium and cook for 10 mins until translucent.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions. Combine all the chilli sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside.

Add the peppers to the pan, then pour in the chilli sauce. Reduce the sauce to your preferred thickness, over a medium heat for 10 mins. Add the paneer back to the pan, tip in the cooked pasta and give everything a good mix.
Serve with chillies and coriander on top.

name: Chilli Tahini Granola
description: Homemade granola is so much better than the shop-bought stuff. This one's special. It's the perfect balance of salty and sweet, with a slight hint of spice. Z x
instructions: Heat your oven to 130°C.
Place the rolled oats, bran flakes, desiccated coconut, chopped nuts, pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds in a large mixing bowl.
Melt the coconut oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the maple syrup, tahini, chilli flakes and ½ teaspoon salt and remove the saucepan from the heat. Whisk until well-combined.
Pour the chilli tahini mixture over the dry ingredients and toss well to coat, ensuring that everything is evenly coated.
Divide the granola between two large baking sheets, spreading it out into an even layer.
Bake for 1 hour or until lightly golden, tossing once halfway through.
Let the granola cool on the baking sheet. It will crisp up further as it cools. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

name: Chilli Tofu & Pineapple Rice Bowl
description: If there's one recipe that will convince you to cook with tofu, this one might be it. Give it a go. Make sure to use extra-firm tofu as it's more protein dense.
instructions: Cook the rice following pack instructions. Stir the stock cube through the water before adding the rice to amp up the flavour.

Meanwhile, wrap the tofu in a clean tea towel and put it on a flat surface. Put a heavy pan on top and leave for 15 mins to drain off the excess water. This part is important: the more water you get out of the tofu the more flavour it will hold and the less likely it will fall apart in the pan.

Slice the pressed tofu and pineapple lengthways into slabs about 1½ cm thick. Using a sharp knife, mark each slab with a diamond pattern then cut each slab in half to create triangles. Slice the limes in half. Drain and rinse the black beans. Finely slice the red cabbage.

Heat a frying pan over a very high heat then add the pineapple steaks and lime halves, with a sprinkling of chilli flakes. Sear for 2-3 mins on each side until the juices start to release. Remove from the pan and set aside.

Add a little olive oil to the pan with the leftover juices and set it over a high heat. Add the tofu steaks and sear for a few minutes on each side until nicely browned. Add the tamari and the juice of one-half of the charred lime and move the steaks around so they’re nicely coated. Once they’re nicely charred, remove from the heat and set aside.
Add the sliced red cabbage to a bowl with the juice from the remaining charred lime and a pinch of sea salt. Mix together with your fingers until it turns a nice bright pink colour.
Divide the rice between four bowls then add the tofu and pineapple steaks, black beans and red cabbage. Finish with a drizzle of chilli oil, the coriander leaves and some toasted seeds, if you like.

name: Chilli, Thyme & Parmesan Roast Fennel Recipe
description: Roasted fennel is an elite side, its aniseed liquorice flavour mellows and it becomes super sweet. Try it alongside a steak with chimichurri or with a roasted shoulder of lamb or chicken. You're going to love this roast fennel recipe, Mob.
instructions: Heat your oven to 180°C. Line a large roasting tray with baking parchment.
Pick any of the green fennel fronds off the fennel and save them to top the roasted fennel later, then cut the roots off each fennel bulb. Cut in half lengthwise then cut each half into 3cm wedges.

Strip the thyme from the sprigs into a large bowl. Zest in the lemon then stir in the chilli flakes and a splash of olive oil. Add the fennel wedges, along with some salt and plenty of black pepper, toss so that the wedges get evenly coated.

Lay the fennel wedges onto the lined tray in an even layer. Roast for 30 mins, turning half way through, until soft and beginning to caramelise. When the fennel is nice and jammy, finely grate over the vegetarian hard cheese. Return to the oven for 10-15 mins until the cheese has melted and the fennel is completely tender.
Transfer the fennel to a serving bowl. Squeeze over the lemon juice and drizzle with a little more olive oil and scatter over the fennel fronds, to serve.

name: Chimichurri Chicken Sandwich
description: A top-tier favourite chicken sandwich. It’s loaded with crispy chicken thighs, a delicious chimichurri sauce, red peppers, avocados and rocket. You’ll love it!
instructions: Finely chop the parsley, oregano, mint, red chilli and red onion and mince the garlic.
Transfer to a mixing bowl and add the red wine vinegar, sugar and 6 tablespoons of olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Season the chicken thigh fillets with salt and pepper. Place them in a cold frying pan, skin-side down.

Heat the frying pan over medium heat and cook the chicken undisturbed for 5 mins, or until the skin is deep golden brown. Flip and cook for a further 4 mins or until cooked through then transfer to a plate to rest.
Heat your oven grill to high. Halve the ciabatta rolls and toast under the grill.
Peel the avocados and thinly slice them.

To assemble, place a heap of rocket on the base of each sandwich. Add half an avocado and 1 red pepper and top with 2 chicken thigh fillets. Generously spoon over some of the chimichurri then finish with the top of the ciabatta. Tuck in and enjoy!

name: Chimichurri Egg Plate
description: We love green eggs. This chimichurri egg plate is bright, packed with herbs, and totally delicious.
instructions: First, make the chimichurri. Finely chop the coriander and parsley (stalks and all), then scrape into a bowl. Finely chop the red chilli and onion and add to the bowl. Stir through the olive oil and vinegar, then season to taste.
Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil. Once boiling, turn the heat down to a simmer and carefully lower in the eggs. Cook for 6½ mins – set a timer. You want them jammy.

Meanwhile, toast the pumpkin seeds in a small, dry frying pan set over a high heat until starting to pop, then set aside. Slice the tomato into rounds and lay across one large platter or two plates, then season. Halve and slice the avocado. Add to the plate in a separate pile along with the tomatoes. Crumble the feta onto another part of the plate.

Drain and rinse the eggs under cold water, then peel and halve. Transfer to serving plates and sprinkle each yolk with a little salt. Spoon the chimichurri over the avocado and tomatoes and scatter the pumpkin seeds over everything. Serve with bread of your choice.

name: Chimichurri Fish Tacos
description: Simple and spicy haddock tacos with a homemade chimichurri sauce you're not going to forget anytime soon. Delicious.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Cut the fillets into rectangular chunks about 7cm x 6cm. Roughly chop the coriander for the fish and cut the lime into thin slices.

Spread a large square of foil onto your work surface – it needs to be large enough that it will encase the fish when wrapped. Place the fish in the middle of the foil, season with a pinch of salt, sprinkle with the chopped coriander and add a slice of lime on top. Seal the foil loosely around the fish, leaving enough space for it to steam, then scrunch the edges to seal together. Transfer to the oven and cook for 8-10 mins until flaking apart.
Meanwhile, prepare the chimichurri. Put the coriander, parsley, garlic, chilli, oil and vinegar into a blender and blitz until everything has broken down. Divide the chimichurri between two bowls.

Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and thirds (the different sizes add to the dish). Crush the pistachios using a tea towel and the back of a rolling pin. Add the cherry tomatoes and pistachios, reserving a small amount of nuts for garnish, to one of the chimichurri bowls and stir well.

Warm the tacos following pack instructions. To assemble, first add a spoon of plain chimichurri to a taco, followed by the cooked fish, tomato chimichurri and, finally, leftover pistachios. If you like a bit of extra heat, which is my preference, add some hot sauce and sliced chillies, too.

name: Chimichurri Steak & Manchego Super Sub
description: A winner for either lunch or dinner. The manchego, chimichurri & steak combo works a charm.
instructions: Place steaks on a board. Cover with cling film. Bash with a rolling pin until about 1.5cm thick. Add to a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper. Cover, and leave to marinate for a minimum of 20 minutes. Leave steaks out of the fridge so they will be at room temperature when you cook them.

Chimichurri time. Grab a bowl. Add a large handful of finely chopped parsley, a large handful of finely chopped coriander, finely chopped shallots, crushed garlic clove, red wine vinegar and 5 tablespoons of olive oil. Mix together.

Heat a griddle pan. Once it is hot, add your steaks. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side. Remove steaks from the heat and lay them on a board. Leave to rest for 5 minutes (will make them more tender) and then slice them up.
Slice open up a sub. Layer on the chimichurri. Add the steak slices and manchego shavings, top with some more chimichurri. Tuck in.

name: Chinese BBQ Chicken
description: If you love char siu, you will love this version using chicken. It’s sticky, sweet and salty. Serve the barbeque chicken with jasmine rice for the perfect weeknight meal.
instructions: Mince the garlic and set aside. Slice your cucumber lengthways and set aside for later.
Add the chicken to a bowl along with all the sauces, seasonings and minced garlic (all the chicken ingredients except the water). Mix well and leave to marinate in the fridge for half an hour.
Heat the oven to 180°C.

Place the chicken thighs on a rack and roast in the oven for 25 mins. Get a large sheet of tin foil and turn up the edges to create a flat bowl then fill it with 100ml water. Pop it in the oven under the chicken to catch the marinade and prevent it from burning.
Whilst the chicken is in roasting, add the leftover marinade to a small saucepan with the water. Bring to a boil then leave to simmer until it’s reduced, sticky and glossy.

Meanwhile, wash your rice three times until the water runs clear. Drain, then transfer to a saucepan and add enough water to reach just below your first knuckle. Bring to the boil over a medium-high heat, then turn the heat to low, cover with a lid and cook for 12 mins.

To make the spring onion ginger oil, slice your spring onions and pound your ginger in a pestle and mortar. Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan set over a medium heat. Once the oil reaches 180°C, add the ginger and cook for 20 seconds. Transfer the oil to a bowl and add the sliced spring onions, salt, sugar and sesame oil. Mix well and set aside.
After the chicken has been roasting for 25 mins, take it out and baste with the reduced marinade in the saucepan then return to the oven to roast for another 5 mins.
Serve your chicken with the rice, spring onion oil, sliced cucumber and some fresh coriander leaves. Add some crispy chilli oil too, if you like.

name: Chinese Cracked Tea Eggs
description: Jammy yolks, spiced soy marinade and that classic marble effect. You'll feel smug with these eggs in your fridge.
instructions: Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil. Gently lower in the eggs and boil for 6 mins. Transfer straight into a bowl of iced water to stop the cooking.

While the eggs are cooling, make the marinade. In a saucepan, combine the soy sauces, tea bags, five spice, star anise, cinnamon stick, sugar and water. Bring to the boil, then let it cool completely.

Once the eggs are cool, drain and roll each one around the empty saucepan to gently crack the shells all over, you want spiderweb cracks, not full-on carnage. If you don't trust yourself to be gentle, try gently tapping the egg with the back of a spoon.
Pop the cracked eggs into a clean jar or container, pour over the cooled marinade and make sure they’re fully submerged. Cover with a piece of kitchen paper and pop the lid on.

Chill in the fridge for at least 12 hrs, ideally 24, to build flavour and get that deep marbling. 
These eggs will last for up to 4 days in the fridge, the flavour gets stronger each day.
When ready to serve, peel and halve. Then crack over some black pepper and serve with whatever you fancy, salads, noodles - it all works!

name: Chinese Hot Pot for One
description: Meet your new favourite solo dinner. We’ve customised this one with beef, fish balls, napa cabbage and mushrooms but you can use any veg or meat you have in the fridge.
keywords: Chinese Hot Pot for One Recipe
instructions: In a medium saucepan, mix the hotpot soup base with boiling water following packet instructions. (You’ll need 500-600ml per person; if you don’t have access to a hotpot base, see notes.) Bring to a boil over a medium-high heat.
Wash all your veg and slice your napa cabbage. Add the napa cabbage and shiitake mushrooms to the boiling broth and cook for 5-6 mins.
Meanwhile, make the dipping sauce: mince the garlic and chop the spring onion. Combine with all the ingredients for the dipping sauce in a small bowl and adjust to taste. Set aside.
Add the fish balls, pak choi, enoki mushroom and noodles to the hot pot and cook for 3 mins (the fish balls will float to the top when cooked).
Slice the steak as thinly as you can and add to the soup and cook for a final 30 seconds or until the beef changes colour.
Garnish with coriander and enjoy your hot pot with the dipping sauce.

name: Chinese Steamed Ginger Chicken
description: A super quick and healthy way to cook chicken thighs. Drizzle with lots of Mama Yu’s Chilli Oil to make your dinner extra delicious.
instructions: Slice the chicken thighs into small pieces and set aside in a heatproof dish. Thinly slice the ginger and add to the chicken. Season the chicken with the remaining ingredients. Mix well and set aside.

Wash your rice three times until the water runs clear. Drain, then transfer to a large saucepan and add water until it reaches just below your first knuckle. Bring to the boil over a medium-high heat, then turn the heat to low and cover with a lid for 12 mins.

To prepare your steaming set up, fill a wok with 3cm water and place a heatproof bowl upside down in the pan. Bring to the boil then turn the heat to low-medium, and place the heatproof dish with the chicken on top of the upside-down heatproof plate. Cover with a lid and steam for 15-20 mins until cooked through.
Meanwhile, thinly slice the spring onion and set aside in a bowl of cold water.
Serve the steamed chicken with the rice and top with the sliced spring onions and lots of chilli oil.

name: Chip Shop Cheesy Curry Udon
description: This is inspired by cheesy curry chips - my go-to late-night scran after a big night out. I've put my twist on it by throwing the flavours into some noodles.
instructions: Cook your noodles according to package instructions then rinse with cold water. Save the water for later.
Grate your cheese into a bowl.
Finely slice your carrots and spring onions, set them aside in separate bowls. Cut the stems off your pak choi, give it a wash and also set aside.

Get a wok on medium heat, pop your curry block in with a tablespoon of oil. Once the mix starts to melt, pour in the water. Give it a good mix and bring the sauce to a boil. Then add your sliced carrots for a minute then your pak choi.
Once the carrots and pak choi are softish, add your grated cheese, most of your spring onions and noodles. Season with salt and pepper and give it another mix.
Plate up your noodles, top with spring onions and enjoy!

name: Chip Shop Fish & Curry Rice Bowl
description: Apparently the way into a Brit's heart is fish fingers and curry sauce. Nostalgic for some, brand new to me - and I fully understand the love for it.
keywords: Chip Shop Fish & Curry Rice Bowl
Chip Shop Fish & Curry Rice Bowl recipe
Chloe René chip shop fish and curry rice bowl
instructions: Cook or reheat the fish fingers according to the packet instructions.

Meanwhile, make the sauce. Add the butter to a small saucepan over a medium heat and, once melted, stir in the tikka masala paste, ginger paste and garlic paste. Pour in most of the water, keeping back a couple of tablespoons, then bring to the boil.

Stir the cornflour into the remaining water until fully dissolved, then pour it into the curry sauce. Stir until thickened and it coats the back of a spoon. Take off the heat, then zest one of the limes and set the zest aside. Squeeze in the juice of the zested lime, season with salt and black pepper, then add the honey a bit at a time, tasting as you go until it's as sweet as you want it.
Cover the peas with boiling water for a couple of minutes to defrost, then drain well. Toss the mint leaves through with the olive oil and season with salt, black pepper and the lime zest.

Reheat the rice according to the packet instructions, then add it to a bowl with the grated cheddar, a couple of spoonfuls of the curry sauce and a third of the fish fingers. Smash everything together so the fish fingers break into the rice. Share between bowls, top with the remaining fish fingers and the pea salad, then drizzle over the last of the curry sauce. Serve with the remaining lime, cut into wedges.

name: Chip Shop Tacos
description: We're obsessed with fish and chips. We're obsessed with tacos. We've combined those two obsessions here for a fish taco recipe inspired by your favourite chippy.
instructions: Cut the chilli in half, remove the seeds and finely dice. Pick the mint leaves, finely chop them and finely dice the onion.

Defrost the peas either in the microwave or by pouring boiling water over them. Add the peas to a bowl along with the chilli, mint and onion. Add the capers, balsamic vinegar, a splash of oil and a pinch of salt to the bowl and stir well. Set aside in the fridge.
For the batter, put the flour into a bowl along with ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper. Add the beer and whisk until smooth.
Cut the cod into chunky fingers about 4cm wide and pat dry.

Cover the bottom of a large, deep frying pan with neutral oil and heat to 180°C. When the oil is ready, immerse the cod fingers in the batter until fully coated and lay directly into the pan. Repeat the process without overfilling the pan. Cook on each side for 3-4 mins or until golden, then transfer to a cooling rack or plate lined with kitchen paper.

For the curry mayo, combine the mayonnaise, curry powder, lemon juice and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir until fully incorporated. Heat the tacos following pack instructions and remove the pea salsa from the fridge.
Assemble by spreading some mayonnaise over a taco, then add a fish finger and a generous helping of pea salsa on top.

name: Chipotle & Pineapple Chicken Traybake
description: This chicken and pineapple traybake is inspired by tacos al pastor. We made it into a bowl with coriander rice and a stunning array of toppings.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Add the chipotle and cumin to a baking tray. Grate the garlic in, season generously with salt and mix together. Toss the chicken through the marinade with a drizzle of olive oil. Arrange the chicken and bake for 15-20 mins until fully cooked.

Meanwhile, trim and slice the pineapple into 2cm chunks. Thinly slice the onion. Put the onion slices into a bowl and squeeze the juice of 1 lime over them. Season with salt and set aside to pickle. Pick half the coriander leaves and finely mince the rest. Dice the avocado into even-sized cubes.
Once the chicken is cooked, add the pineapple to the tray, switch the oven setting to grill and cook until the pineapple and chicken start to char.
Reheat the rice and stir the minced coriander and zest of half a lime through. Season with salt.
Share the rice between bowls, then top with the chicken and pineapple, avocado, pickled onions, store-bought tomatillo salsa and remaining coriander leaves.

name: Chipotle Chicken BLT
description: The BLT, but better. Leftovers from your Juicy Pulled Chipotle Chicken batch get upgraded with crispy bacon, crunchy lettuce and salsa - all loaded into one outrageously good sarnie.
instructions: Make the Juicy Pulled Chipotle Chicken.
Set a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Once hot, fry the bacon until golden and crispy on both sides. Transfer to a plate lined with kitchen paper.
Shred the lettuce. Add the pulled chipotle chicken to the empty frying pan and warm through until piping hot. Add a splash of water if it needs loosening.
Toast the bread slices if you like. Spread salsa onto half the slices and mayo onto the other half.

Layer up: start with lettuce on the mayo side, add a generous spoonful of the hot chicken, top with crispy bacon and close with the salsa-covered slice.
Slice up and get stuck in!

name: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: Elevating leftovers from your Juicy Pulled Chipotle Chicken batch with all the best bits of a burrito. The definition of a speedy midweek dinner.
instructions: Make the Juicy Pulled Chipotle Chicken.
Thinly slice the red onion and add to a bowl. Squeeze over the juice of half the lime, season with salt and set aside to pickle.
Finely chop the coriander, saving a few whole leaves for garnish. Crumble the feta and have your guac and crispy corn ready.
Reheat the rice and chipotle chicken in separate saucepans until piping hot. Stir the chopped coriander through the hot rice and squeeze over the juice of the remaining lime.

Build your bowls: start with a layer of coriander rice, then add pulled chipotle chicken, crumbled feta, spoonfuls of guac, pickled onions and a good handful of crunchy corn. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with a lime wedge.

name: Chipotle Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Yes, it's a chicken Caesar salad, but not as you know it. This jalapeño-laden take on that classic sal is creamy, spicy, and perfect for a dinner party spread.
instructions: Heat your oven to 200°C/354°F.
Chop your chicken into bite-sized pieces. Place your thighs in a bowl and add your chipotle paste, cumin, a big pinch of salt and some olive oil. Mix to combine.
Add your chicken to a roasting tray and bake for 30 mins until tender and lightly caramelised.

Tear your ciabatta loaf into small bite-sized pieces. Toss them onto a large baking tray and add a good pinch of salt and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss to totally coat, then bake for 10 mins until golden and crispy.
Cook your corn in a hot griddle pan until lightly charred.
Separate your egg and pop your yolk in a small food processor. Save your white for another occasion.
Add your jalapeños, along with 25ml of the jalapeño brine, mustard, grated parmesan and lime juice to the food processor, then give it a whizz to combine.
Very gradually pour in 150ml of vegetable oil to the egg mixture. Loosen to a thinner consistency with 2 tbsp water, then season to taste with salt and pepper.
Once your corn is cool enough to handle, shave the kernels off. Chop your avocados into chunks.
Cut the end off your lettuces and separate the leaves. Put them in a large mixing bowl and add your croutons, chicken, avocado, charred corn and dressing. Toss to combine.
Spoon your salad onto plates and sprinkle with extra parmesan. Serve and enjoy.

name: Chipotle Chicken Cheesy Chips
description: Willy makes the ultimate cheesy chips, packed with chipotle chicken, avo cream and cheese. Perfect to eat while watching your fave film on Amazon Prime Video.
instructions: Peel your onion and garlic. Blend your chipotle chilli flakes, half of your paprika and cayenne, some black pepper, your garlic, onion, a pinch of salt, cumin, oregano, cider vinegar and tomato purée in a food processor. Blend to a paste.
Score your chicken legs, pop them in a freezer bag and cover with your chipotle marinade. Refrigerate for a few hours to let the flavours sink in.
Preheat oven to 180°C/356°F.

Tip your frozen french fries onto a baking tray. Add your remaining cayenne and paprika along with a little salt and black pepper, then toss until the fries are coated. Remove your chicken from it's marinade and add to another baking dish. Bake both trays for about 30 mins until the fries are crisp and the chicken is cooked through.
Once cooked, retain the cooking liquid and pop it into a pan to heat up.
When your chicken is cooked, pour the cooking liquid into a pan and heat it up. Leave the chips in the oven to crisp up if they need a bit longer.
Use two forks to shred the chicken from the bone.
Add the cooked chicken into the cooking liquid and heat up until the chicken is warmed through and becomes delicious juicy pulled chipotle chicken.
Cut open the avocado and pop it into a food processor. Add sour cream and the juice of your lime. Blend to create an avocado crema.

Pop your fries in a large ovenproof dish, then cover with your pulled chipotle chicken. Grate over your cheddar cheese, then pop under a hot grill until the cheese has melted. Top with your avocado crema, jalapeños and some fresh coriander leaves. Bang. Done

name: Chipotle Chicken Mac and Cheese
description: The Receipts came to the studio to cook up an absolute banger. Your classic mac and cheese has been pimped up with spicy chipotle chicken and lots of spices.
instructions: Heat your oven to 190°C.
Halve your peppers and discard any seeds.

Add your chicken to a baking tray along with your halved peppers, chipotle paste, a drizzle of olive oil and a good pinch of salt. Mix to combine with your hands, then bake for 40 mins, turning half way through.
Melt your butter in a large pan. Add your cumin seeds and toast for a minute. Add your flour, smoked paprika and cayenne pepper, then cook out for 2 mins.

Gradually pour in your milk in small increments, beating with your spoon all the while until you have a smooth mixture before adding more milk. Once all the milk is added, bring your mixture to a boil. Simmer for 2 mins until the mixture thickens.
Peel your peppers and tear them into strips. Shred your chicken with forks.
Get a pan of water on to boil. When bubbling, season liberally with salt and tip in your macaroni. Cook according to packet instructions, then drain in a colander.
Heat your grill to high.
Add your cooked macaroni, all but a handful of cheddar, all but a handful of mozzarella, chicken and peppers to the pan. Give it all a good mix and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Pour it into a dish and top with your extra mozzarella and cheddar. Grill for 5 mins until bubbly.

name: Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas
description: Quesadillas on the barbecue? Go on then. These chicken quesadillas are dead simple and we’ve used the Weber Crafted Griddle to give them a proper char. B x
instructions: Heat the Weber Crafted Griddle over high heat.
Toss the tomatoes, red onion and chillies in vegetable oil and grill until very charred.

Transfer to a cutting board and chop together with the juice of one lime, fresh coriander and a generous pinch of salt until a chunky salsa forms. Alternatively, you can do this with a mortar and pestle. Refrigerate until ready to use.
Slice the chicken and the large onion, and place in a mixing bowl.

Combine the chipotle chilli flakes, ground cumin, smoked paprika, garlic granules, chipotle paste and ½ teaspoon salt in a small bowl. Add the spice mix to the chicken with a splash of vegetable oil and toss to coat.
Heat the Weber Crafted Griddle on a medium-high heat. Cook the chicken, stirring often, until cooked through and charred in places.
Combine the cheeses in a bowl.

Place a small handful of cheese on half of a flour tortilla. Add a good dollop of the chipotle chicken mix and top with another small handful of cheese. Fold the tortilla half over the filling, pressing to smoosh it down, then brush with oil. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Heat the Weber Crafted Griddle over medium heat. Cook the quesadillas until browned on the outside and gooey in the middle, around 2 to 3 mins per side. Cut the lime into 4 wedges.
Serve topped with the charred salsa and lime wedges.
Get stuck in.

name: Chipotle Chicken Tacos With Green Tahini Slaw
description: These are the easiest, tastiest tacos on the block. The star of the show are simply spiced chicken legs roasted over thinly sliced, jammy onions.
instructions: Toast the coriander seeds and cumin seeds in a dry frying pan, then coarsely grind in a pestle and mortar. Add the chipotle paste and a glug of oil and mix to a loose-ish paste.
Slash the skin of the chicken legs 4-5 times with a sharp knife. Rub with plenty of salt and the spice mix, then set aside.
Thinly slice the onions and the garlic. Preheat the oven to 220°C.
Set an ovenproof, flameproof casserole or roasting tray over a high heat. Add a glug of olive oil and the sliced onions with a big pinch of salt. Cook for 5 mins until starting to caramelise.

Add the garlic, stir through and sit the chicken on top along with all the marinade. Chuck the whole lot in the oven for 35-40 mins or until the skin is crispy and chicken is cooked through and tender.
Blend the tahini with the jalapeños, the coriander, a splash of jalapeno liquor and a splash of water. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime if needed.
Now, thinly slice the cabbage and onion, then add to a large mixing bowl. Pour over the tahini sauce and chuck in the remaining jalapenos. Roughly chop the remaining coriander and add to the bowl.
Toss everything together and add a squeeze of lime if necessary.
Heat your tortillas according to the pack instructions.
Pull your chicken out of the oven and rest for a couple of minutes. Shred the meat off the bone with a couple of forks.
Build your tacos up with plenty of the caramelised onions, pulled chicken, slaw and top with a squeeze of lime. Get stuck in.

name: Chipotle Chicken Traybake
description: We love a chicken traybake recipe. It's a surefire way to get a dinner that the whole family will enjoy. We'd recommend serving this nice and spicy chicken traybake with rice or whatever else you like.
instructions: Preheat the grill to high.
Cut the chicken thighs into quarters and finely slice the onions.
In a large bowl, mix the chicken and onions with the chipotle paste, garlic powder, oregano, ground cumin, olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Spread the mixture evenly on a baking tray.
Place under the grill on the top shelf and cook for 15-20 minutes, turning halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve immediately with your favourite sides.

name: Chipotle Chicken with Lemony Kale Rice
description: Juicy, smoky chipotle chicken meets buttery garlic rice, lemony kale and loads of flavour. This ones super easy and perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Heat your oven grill to high (around 230°C).
Cut the chicken thighs into quarters. Peel and finely slice the onions. Peel and grate the garlic.
Chuck the chicken, onions, chipotle paste, garlic, oregano, cumin, olive oil, salt and pepper into a large bowl. Toss until everything is coated.

Spread the chicken mix onto a baking tray in an even layer. Slide under the grill on the top shelf and cook for 15–20 mins, turning halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and starting to char at the edges.
While the chicken cooks, peel and finely chop the remaining garlic. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the garlic and fry for 1 min until fragrant.
Add the kale and cook for 2–3 mins until starting to wilt. Stir in the rice, water, a good pinch of salt and the zest of half the lemon.

Bring to the boil, cover with a lid and turn the heat down to low. Cook for 12 mins, then remove from the heat and leave to steam, covered, for 5 mins. Fluff up the rice with a fork and squeeze over the juice of the lemon.
Serve the chipotle chicken over the rice with the lime, cut into wedges, some grated Cheddar and a big dollop of yoghurt.

name: Chipotle Glazed Plant-Based Burger
description: Smoky sweet glazed vegan burger patty with a herby coriander and pickled jalapeño mayo between fluffy vegan brioche buns.
instructions: Trim and thinly slice the shallot. Add it to a cold pan with 60ml of oil. Place on medium heat, and cook for 10-15 mins until lightly golden. Using a slotted spoon, remove the shallots from the oil and place them onto a plate lined with kitchen paper. Transfer 30ml of the oil into a medium bowl.
Finely chop the pickled jalapeños and the coriander, and add them into the medium bowl containing your shallot oil. Add the mayo and mustard and whisk together until incorporated.

Using the same pan you cooked the shallots in, place it on a medium-high heat, and add a drizzle of oil if it needs it. Once hot, cook the burger patties on both sides until golden brown, 3-4 mins. Add the chipotle paste and agave nectar, stir together and take it off the heat. Glaze the burger patties in the chipotle glaze.
Toast the buns, slice the tomato into 1cm slices.
Spread the coriander and pickled jalapeño mayo onto both cut sides of the bun. Top with two chipotle glazed patties per burger, a slice of tomato, some lettuce, and the crispy shallots.

name: Chipotle Mozzarella Sticks
description: Perfectly crispy, served with the my delicious smoky chipotle sauce. Seema x
instructions: Cut the mozzarella into short, evenly sized sticks.

Place the flour into a bowl with 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp oregano and ½ tsp salt. Crack the eggs into another bowl and whisk in the milk. Pour the panko bread crumbs into a separate bowl and add 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp oregano and ½ tsp salt.

Take one mozzarella stick, dredge in the flour, shaking off the excess. Dip into the egg mixture and then into the panko, pressing well so the panko sticks. Repeat this process so each stick is double coated. Repeat for all of the mozzarella sticks and pop them into the freezer whilst you make the sauce.
Finely slice the garlic.

Pour a large glug of oil into a pan and gently fry the garlic on a low heat. Add in the chipotle paste and cook for a further 4 mins. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and cook on a low heat for 10 mins. Finish with 100ml of water and a pinch of salt.

Fill a large pot with vegetable oil and heat up over a medium high heat. Working in batches, fry the mozzarella, turning frequently until it is golden brown, around 2-3 mins. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate.
Serve hot with the smoky chipotle sauce

name: Chipotle Mushroom & Egg Breakfast Tacos
description: A healthy, high-protein breakfast. These mushroom and egg tacos are perfect for the weekend.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slice the mushrooms into 1cm-thick slices. Put the chipotle into a large bowl with a generous drizzle of olive oil. Season with salt and toss through the sliced mushrooms. Put the mushrooms onto a baking tray and roast for 15-20 mins until golden brown.
Meanwhile, put all the crema ingredients (minus the lime) into a blender and blitz until smooth. Zest half the lime in, then taste and season with salt, pepper and lime juice.

Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with salt and whisk together until smooth. Place a dry non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Once hot, toast the seeds (you know they’re ready once they start popping) and then transfer to a bowl.
Add a drizzle of oil to the now-empty frying pan, then pour the eggs in. Continuously stir until a fluffy scramble forms. Remove from the heat whilst the eggs are still slightly runny.
Heat the tortillas in a dry frying pan, then load them up with crema, chipotle mushrooms, scrambled eggs, toasted seeds, coriander and chilli flakes. Serve with any remaining lime, cut into wedges.

name: Chipotle Mushroom Tacos
description: Smoky roast mushroom tacos with a fresh and zingy avocado salsa. An incredible quick midweek meal that’s packed with plants.
instructions: Shred the oyster mushrooms with a fork and add to a large pan with a glug of olive oil. Set the pan over a medium heat and cook the mushrooms until crispy, being careful not to stir too often.
Meanwhile, shred the red cabbage, crush the garlic and roughly chop the jalapeño and set aside.
Once the mushrooms are cooked, add the garlic and chipotle paste to the pan and season with salt and pepper. Cook for a further 30 seconds or so.
While the mushrooms are cooking, make an avocado dressing: blend or smash together the avocado, jalapeño, lime juice and coriander and season to taste.
Now make the slaw: get the shredded cabbage in a bowl and use ½ of the avocado mixture to dress it. Keep the rest of the dressing aside for assembling your tacos.
Heat the tortillas following pack instructions then top with the avocado dressing, the slaw, cooked mushrooms, sauerkraut and a few jalapeños.

name: Chipotle Mushroom Tacos With Green Tahini Slaw
description: These super savoury tacos are an absolute godsend. This recipe is the perfect dish to whip up when you want to impress guests with minimal effort.
keywords: Chipotle Mushroom Tacos With Green Tahini Slaw
instructions: Toast the coriander seeds and cumin seeds in a dry frying pan, then coarsely grind in a pestle and mortar. Add the chipotle paste and a glug of oil and mix to a loose-ish paste.
Grab the mushrooms and rub with plenty of salt and the spice mix, then set aside.
Thinly slice three of the onions and the garlic. Preheat the oven to 220°C.
Set an ovenproof, flameproof casserole or roasting tray over a high heat. Add a glug of olive oil and the sliced onions with a big pinch of salt. Cook for 5 mins until starting to caramelise.
Add the garlic, stir through and sit the mushrooms on top along with all the marinade. Chuck the whole lot in the oven for 35-40 mins or until the onions are jammy and the mushrooms are tender.
Meanwhile, blend the tahini with a handful of the jalapeños, one bunch of coriander, a splash of jalapeño liquor and a splash of water. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime if needed.

Now, thinly slice the cabbage and remaining onion, then add to a large mixing bowl. Pour over the tahini mixture and chuck in the remaining jalapeños. Roughly chop the remaining coriander and add to the bowl.
Toss everything together and add a squeeze of lime if necessary.
Heat your tortillas according to the pack instructions.
Pull your mushrooms out of the oven and rest for a couple of minutes. Shred with a couple of forks.
Build your tacos up with plenty of caramelised onions, pulled ’shrooms, slaw and a squeeze of lime. Get stuck in.

name: Chipotle Pork & Bean Loaded Sweet Potatoes
description: Sweet, smoky, and spicy. Loaded sweet potatoes with chipotle pork, beans, and lime yoghurt. Delicious.
instructions: Heat the oven to 210°C. Prick the sweet potatoes all over and place them on a foil-lined baking tray. Bake for 40–45 mins until tender.

Meanwhile, finely chop the mushrooms. Chuck them into a nonstick frying pan with the pork mince. Set over a medium-high heat and cook for about 10 mins, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through.

Add the black beans (including their liquid) to the pan along with most of the chipotle paste – keep a little back for the yoghurt. Add a splash of water and let everything simmer for 15 mins, topping up with more water if it starts looking dry.

Zest the lime over the yoghurt, then squeeze in the juice from half. Stir through the reserved chipotle paste. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop most of them, then fold those through the yoghurt too. Season to taste. Cut the remaining lime into wedges.

Cut open the sweet potatoes and lightly fluff the insides with a fork. Pile on the chipotle pork and bean mixture, then dollop over the yoghurt. Scatter with the reserved coriander leaves and serve with lime wedges on the side.

name: Chipotle Pork Steaks with Charred Pineapple Salsa
description: This pork steak recipe is all about the char. Be sure to get the pineapple nice and blackened for the salsa, as well as on the pork to complement the smoky sweetness of the chipotle. This piece of meat has some great flavours that come together to make a meal you won’t forget in a hurry.
keywords: Chipotle Pork Steaks with Charred Pineapple Salsa
Chipotle Pork Steaks with Charred Pineapple Salsa recipe
instructions: Put the pork steaks into a bowl, scatter in the cumin seeds and spoon in the chipotle paste. Peel the garlic clove and bash with the side of your knife, then add to the bowl. Season really well with salt and black pepper, then zest in 1 of the limes, then halve and squeeze in the juice. Leave to marinate for 1 hour.

Cut the cherry tomatoes into small pieces, then peel and really finely chop the red onion. Scrape into a bowl and squeeze in the juice of the remaining lime and add a pinch of salt and pepper. Roughly chop ¾ of the coriander and stir through the salsa.

Drain the pineapple from its juice (drink it!) and pat dry with kitchen paper. Heat a frying pan over a high heat and add the pineapple pieces to the pan. Cook for 2 minutes on each side until charred, then remove onto a plate.
Put the pan back over the heat, drizzle in 1 tbsp oil and cook the pork steaks for 3 mins on each side until charred and caramelised. Move onto a plate and leave to rest for 5 mins.
Finely chop the charred pineapple and add to the cherry tomato salsa. Mix well.
Slice the pork steaks and serve topped with the charred pineapple salsa and a final sprinkling of coriander leaves.

name: Chipotle Prawn & Fish Taco Traybake
description: Flaky hake and juicy king prawns baked in a smoky, creamy chipotle-coconut sauce, piled into warm corn tortillas with pickled shallots, fresh mango and a squeeze of lime.
keywords: Prawn & Fish Tacos with Chipotle-Coconut Sauce
Prawn & Fish Tacos with Chipotle-Coconut Sauce recipe
instructions: Heat the oven to 240°C. Place the hake fillets in a 30 x 23cm baking tray and season with 1 tsp of the fine sea salt.
Add all the chipotle-coconut sauce ingredients to a blender, blitz until super smooth, then pour over the fish. Bake near the top of the oven for 15 mins.

Meanwhile, peel the shallots and slice into thin rounds. Squeeze the juice of one of the limes over the shallots, add the cracked black pepper, mix well and set aside. Then peel the mango and chop into small cubes.

Mix the prawns with the olive oil, chipotle paste and the remaining pinch of fine sea salt. Spoon on top of the fish fillets, then bake for a further 5 mins until the prawns are pink and the sauce is bubbling.
Mix the chipotle oil ingredients together and set aside.
Heat a frying pan over a high heat and brush with a little olive oil. Cook the tortillas for 1 min on each side until lightly browned but still soft. Keep warm in a clean tea towel.

Flake the fish and pile into the warm tortillas along with the prawns and sauce. Top with the yoghurt, a drizzle of chipotle oil, the pickled shallots and mango. Serve with the remaining lime, cut into wedges for squeezing over everything.

name: Chipotle Pulled Chicken Enchiladas
description: Smoky, cheesy enchiladas stuffed with juicy pulled chicken leftovers and sweetcorn, baked until golden and topped with a creamy dollop of sour cream.
instructions: Before you begin, make the Juicy Pulled Chipotle Chicken Traybake batch recipe.
Heat the oven to 200°C.
Heat a dry frying pan over a high heat. Drain the sweetcorn and add to the pan, cook for 4-5 mins, stirring occasionally, until charred in places. Set aside.
Grate the Cheddar and finely chop the coriander. Shred the pulled chicken and mix it in a bowl with half the grated cheddar and half the charred corn. Season with a pinch of salt.

Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave so they’re soft and easy to roll. Spoon the filling into the centre of each tortilla, roll up tightly and place seam-side down into a small baking dish.
Pour the enchilada sauce over the top, letting it pool around the edges, then scatter over the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 15–20 mins until golden and bubbling. Top with the rest of the charred corn, chopped coriander and a dollop of sour cream, if using.  Now get stuck in!

name: Chipotle Roast Corn, Marinated Feta & Wild Rice Salad
description: Smoky-sweet roasted corn, chipotle-spiked rice, zingy marinated feta and loads of fresh lime. This is the salad that eats like a full-on meal.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Drain the sweetcorn really well, then spread it out on a baking tray. Drizzle over half of the olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and roast for 15–20 mins, tossing halfway, until golden and crisp at the edges.

Toast the cumin seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 1–2 mins until fragrant, then tip into a bowl. Crumble in the feta into big bite-sized chunks. Zest and juice in one of the limes, add the remaining olive oil, and stir gently. Set aside to marinate at room temperature while the corn roasts.

Heat the rice pouch according to pack instructions. Tip into a large bowl, season with salt and pepper, then zest and juice in the second lime. Stir through the chipotle paste and baby spinach while the rice is still warm to help it wilt slightly.
Divide the chipotle rice between containers or bowls. Top with the roasted corn, marinated feta and a scattering of fresh coriander.

name: Chipotle Roast Lamb Tacos
description: Leftover Garlicky Slow-Roast Lamb Leg tossed with smoky chipotle paste and piled into warm corn tortillas with pickled jalapeños, avocado and a squeeze of lime.
instructions: Before you begin, make the Garlicky Slow Roast Lamb batch recipe.
Peel and finely dice the onion. Peel and slice the avocado. Pick the coriander leaves. Cut the lime into wedges.
Reheat the lamb in a frying pan over a medium heat until piping hot, then stir through the chipotle paste. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a flame for 30 seconds each side, then wrap in a clean tea towel to keep warm until you're ready to assemble.
Load the tortillas with the lamb, diced onion, jalapeños and coriander. Squeeze over the lime wedges and get stuck in.

name: Chipotle Spatchcock Chicken with Corn Ribs and Avocado Crema
description: This spicy barbecue chicken is a summer party showstopper. Cooked on a gorgeous Weber barbecue and served with crispy corn ribs, avo crema, and tomato salsa.
instructions: Set up you Weber barbecue for indirect cooking and preheat to 200°C, or heat your oven to 200°C/400°F.
Combine your chipotle chilli paste, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika and the zest and juice of ½ lime in a bowl with a good pinch of salt and 1 tbsp of olive oil.

Chicken time. Lay the chicken on your chopping board breast-side down then, using a pair of scissors, cut either side of the backbone to remove it. Once the bone is removed, turn the chicken breast-side up and, using your hands, apply some weight to the chicken to flatten it.
Rub your chipotle marinade all over your chicken.

Place the chicken breast-side up on the barbecue over the area with no direct heat, or on a tray in the oven. If roasting in the oven, cook for 45 mins until cooked through. For the Weber barbecue, cook the chicken breast-side up for 40 mins with the lid down.
Flip the chicken and finish cooking it breast-side down for 10 mins over a direct heat. Remove from the barbecue when the internal temperature reaches 73°C. Let the chicken rest for 20 mins.

Make your jalapeño crema. Roughly chop your jalapeño and your avocados. Pop them in a blender along with your sour cream, the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt, then blend to combine. Check the seasoning.
Finely dice your red onion. Halve your cherry tomatoes. Finely chop your coriander.
Add your tomatoes to a bowl with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt, then scrunch up with your hands. Add your tomatoes and toss to combine.

Cut your corn into ribs, then rub them with salt and olive oil. Whack those on the barbecue over a direct heat for the final 20 mins of the chicken cooking. If cooking in the oven, place them on a baking tray and cook for the final 20 mins of the chicken cooking, turning them halfway through.
Place your chicken on a platter and surround it with your tomato salsa, corn ribs and a bowl of avocado crema. Sprinkle with a little coriander, then carve up the chicken and serve.

name: Chipotle Tacos With Tomato Strawberry Salsa, Salsa Verde & Toasted Pistachios
description: Adding in-season strawberries to your salsa creates a fresh, juicy and subtly sweet flavour that pairs beautifully with smoky chipotle-roasted mushrooms.
keywords: Chipotle Tacos With Tomato Strawberry Salsa
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Cut the mushrooms into thin, uniform slices. Transfer to a bowl, then add the chipotle paste, 3 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt. Toss to combine until the mushrooms are evenly coated in chipotle marinade.

Lay the mushrooms in a single layer on a baking tray (you might need to use two trays), then place the jalapeños, garlic and onion for the coriander salsa on the side of one tray. Roast for 30 mins, checking halfway.

Meanwhile, make the strawberry tomato salsa by cutting the strawberries and tomatoes into small cubes. Transfer to a bowl, squeeze in the lime juice, then add the olive oil and salt to taste. Toss to combine.

Heat a medium-sized shallow frying pan over a medium-high heat. Remove the pistachio skins, then put the pistachios in the pan and gently stir. Cook for 3-5 mins until fragrant. Remove from the pan, place on a chopping board and roughly chop. Set aside.

For the coriander salsa, put the coriander, tomato, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lime juice, roasted jalapeños and roasted onion into a food processor. Lastly, squeeze the roasted garlic into the food processor and blitz to combine. If needed, add a small splash of water to loosen.
Load your tacos up with roasted chipotle mushrooms, a drizzle of coriander salsa, a spoon of strawberry tomato salsa, avocado slices, a squeeze of fresh lime juice and a sprinkle of pistachio nuts.

name: Chipotle Tempeh Tacos
description: Smoky chipotle tempeh, zesty cavolo, and creamy yoghurt all wrapped up in soft corn tortillas. Made for midweek dinners.
instructions: Crumble the tempeh into mince-sized pieces. Heat the oil in a frying pan set over a medium-high heat. Add the tempeh and fry for 4–5 mins until golden and crisp at the edges. Stir in the soy sauce and chipotle paste, and cook for another couple of minutes until everything’s well coated.

Strip the cavolo nero leaves from their stalks, then finely slice them. Add to a bowl with a pinch of salt and the juice of half the lime. Use your hands to massage the cavolo until it softens and darkens in colour.
Char the tortillas in a dry frying pan or directly over a gas flame for 20–30 seconds on each side until soft and blistered.
Pick the coriander leaves.

To assemble, spread the yoghurt onto each tortilla, then layer up with the cavolo nero and smoky chipotle tempeh. Finish with pickled onions and a scattering of coriander leaves. Serve with the remaining lime on the side for squeezing.

name: Chipotle Tofu & Coriander Rice Bowl
description: Fresh, herby and ready in 15 minutes, this bowl takes your chipotle tofu mince and pairs it with coriander-flecked rice, crisp pickled radishes and a dollop of soured cream. Meal prep never looked this good.
keywords: Chipotle Tofu & Coriander Rice Bowl recipe
instructions: Thinly slice the radishes (a mandolin works great here if you have one). Add to a small bowl, season with salt and squeeze over the lime juice. Set aside to lightly pickle while you prep everything else.
Finely mince most of the coriander (stalks and all) leaving a few leaves aside for garnish.
Reheat the rice and chipotle tofu mince separately until piping hot, adding a splash of water to the tofu mince if it needs loosening.

Fluff the rice and stir through the minced coriander. Divide between bowls, top with the chipotle tofu mince, radish salad and a generous dollop of soured cream. Finish with the reserved coriander leaves and serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges.

name: Chipotle Tofu Burritos
description: Crispy, melty, stuffed-to-bursting burritos with your leftover smoky chipotle tofu batch, Cheddar and creamy avocado. Make a batch and freeze them, future you will be very pleased.
instructions: Thinly slice the avocado and grate the Cheddar.
Reheat the rice and chipotle tofu mince separately until piping hot. Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for a few seconds on each side until soft and pliable.

To build the burritos, lay a tortilla flat and add a generous spoonful of rice to the centre. Top with the chipotle tofu mince, then scatter over the Cheddar and lay over the avocado slices. Fold the sides in over the filling, then roll tightly away from you. Repeat with the second tortilla.

Return the frying pan to a medium heat. Add the burritos seam-side down and cook for 1-2 mins until sealed and lightly golden. Eat straight away, or wrap each burrito tightly in baking paper then foil and freeze for later.From frozen: unwrap and place on a microwave-safe plate, cover loosely with a lid or an upside-down bowl and microwave for 3-4 mins, flipping halfway. Then transfer to an air fryer at 180°C for 15-20 mins, or a preheated oven at 180°C for 20-25 mins, until piping hot throughout.From chilled: wrap in a lightly damp piece of kitchen paper to keep the tortilla soft. Microwave for 1-2 mins, flipping halfway, then air fry at 180°C for 8-10 mins, or bake in the oven at 160°C for 15 mins, until piping hot throughout.

name: Chipotle Tofu Rice Bowl
description: We have slathered the best sticky, smoky sauce on crispy tofu. Charred corn and spiced salsa. Fluffy rice is essential to mop up all those glorious juices.
instructions: Wash your Tilda Brown Basmati Rice in cold water, then pop it in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring the rice to a simmer, then cover with a lid and cook for 20-25 minutes until cooked through.
Heat your grill to its highest setting.
Rub your corn with oil and salt, then pop onto a tray and grill until it is charred and blistered, turning occasionally so it cooks evenly.
Once cool enough to handle, slice off the corn from the cob and set aside.

Chop up the tofu into 2cm squares. Mix 2 tbsp of your cornflour, cayenne pepper, oregano, garlic powder and ground cumin together in a bowl with a pinch of salt and add your tofu. Toss to coat your tofu in the spiced flour mixture.
Add a small glug of oil into a frying pan and fry the tofu on all sides until golden brown for 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate lined with a paper towel.

In the same pan, add a little oil and grate in your clove of garlic. Fry for one minute, then add your tomato purée and cook for 5 minutes until it is a dark brown. Add in the chipotle paste and the agave.

Mix your remaining cornflour with 1 tbsp water. Pour 250ml water into your pan, then add your cornstarch slurry. Mix well until combined, then simmer until you have a thick sauce. Toss in the tofu and coat, adding a little more water to loosen if necessary.
Finely chop up the red onion, coriander and green chilli. Dice the tomatoes.
Combine the tomatoes, coriander, chilli and half of the red onion in a bowl. Squeeze in the juice of a lime and season with salt.

Back to the rice. In another pan, fry your remaining red onion and cumin seeds in oil for 5-6 minutes until softened. Add in the tin of drained black beans and mix gently to warm through. Drain the cooked rice and stir through with the beans.
Time to plate up. Spoon some rice into your bowl and top with your chipotle tofu, tomato salsa and corn. Dig in.

name: Chipotle Tuna Quesadillas
description: Smokey chipotle tuna with melted cheese and sandwiched between two golden tortillas. Not traditional by any stretch, but still delicious.
instructions: Dice the avocados, thinly slice the spring onion. Transfer both into a bowl with some lime juice. Sprinkle in the cumin, season with salt and pepper, toss together, and set aside. Drain the sweetcorn.

Put the oven on a low heat to keep quesadillas warm once cooked. Place a frying pan over high heat (no oil). Once hot, add the sweetcorn and cook until starting to char. Tip into the avocado bowl. Keep the frying pan (we reuse it later).
Drain the tuna then mix in a bowl with the chipotle paste, season with salt. Grate the cheddar
Spread the spicy tuna across one half of all the tortillas and top with the cheddar. Fold each in half to close.

Place the empty frying pan back over medium heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, place the quesadillas in and cook on both sides until golden brown, and the cheese has melted. Keep warm in the oven whilst you repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Toss the salad together and share between plates. Serve the quesadillas alongside with any remaining lime wedges.

name: Choccy Peanut Butter Dates
description: A fun, no-fuss treat made with just three ingredients. These chocolate peanut butter dates are naturally sweet, non-processed, and perfect for the whole family.
instructions:
1 Serving = 1 Date
Remove the stones from the dates. Line a large baking tray with baking paper, open up the dates slightly and spoon 1 tsp of peanut butter into each. Freeze for 1 hour.
Snap the chocolate into pieces and add to a bowl. Melt in 20 second pulses in the microwave.

Put a date onto a small fork and lower it into the chocolate, then back onto the lined tray. Repeat, then freeze for 10 minutes. 
Keep in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer for an easy sweet snack.
Keep in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer, ready to satisfy a sweet craving.

name: Chocolate & Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
description: A classic bake that we’ve made gluten free, using ground almonds in place of flour. It’s citrussy, light and incredibly moreish. Perfect with a cup of tea.
keywords: Gluten-Free Lemon Poppy Seed Cake recipe
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C. Grease and line a 1Ib loaf tin with parchment paper. Make sure your butter is at room temperature.
Add the butter and sugar to a large mixing bowl and beat together for 3-4 mins until pale and fluffy.
Separate the egg yolks and whites into two separate bowls. Whisk the yolks together then add the ground almonds, cocoa powder, salt, poppy seeds and baking powder and mix to combine.
In a separate bowl, use an electric whisk to beat the egg whites until thick and white with stiff peaks forming.
By hand, stir ½ the egg yolk mix into the butter and sugar mix, then fold in ½ the egg whites.
Gently fold in the remaining egg yolk mix followed by the remaining egg whites, until just fully incorporated. Don't overwork the mixture as you want to keep the air in the egg whites.
Pour the mixture into the tin and bake for 30-40 mins until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Leave to cool for 10 mins in the tin then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
For the icing, sift the icing sugar into a bowl and mix together with enough lemon juice to give it a pouring consistency, then pour the icing over the top of the cake.

name: Chocolate & Pistachio Pots
description: These quick and easy chocolate pistachio pots are the perfect dinner party dessert. You can't go wrong with serving these to your mates.
instructions:
Add the custard to a bowl. Roughly chop the chocolate and place in a heatproof
bowl. Melt over a pan of simmering water, or in the microwave.

Beat the melted chocolate into the custard with a good pinch of salt and divide
between ramekins or glasses.
Allow to set in the fridge for a minimum of 3 hours, overnight if easier.

Whip the crème fraîche with a whisk until it holds a soft peak. Spoon over the
chocolate pots and scrunch over the pistachios.

name: Chocolate & Raspberry Protein Overnight Oats
description: A classic overnight oats recipe that you can adapt with your own favourite milks, flavourings and toppings. They’re super quick and easy to prepare and are the perfect make-ahead breakfast or post-workout refuel snack.
keywords: Chocolate & Raspberry Protein Overnight Oats recipe
instructions: Combine the oats, protein powder, cocoa powder and chia seeds in a dish, pot, tub or jar with a lid.
Pour in the milk, yoghurt and honey and mix until combined.
Put the lid on and store in the fridge overnight (or for at least 3 hours).
When ready to eat, remove from the fridge and top with an extra layer of yoghurt, some raspberries, a drizzle of honey and some shaved or broken-up dark chocolate.

name: Chocolate Bao Buns
description: Making homemade bao buns isn't hard at all. We've stuffed each pillowy bite with a rich, chocolate custard. Divine.
instructions: Carefully separate the egg whites from the yolk, you'll use the yolk for the custard and whites for the dough.

Into a large bowl, combine all the dry dough ingredients and mix well. Then add the egg white with the remaining wet dough ingredients. Use a spoon to bring the dough together until big clumps have formed, then use your hands to bring the dough together.

Knead the dough for 8 mins, punching it away from you then sliding it back, until a smooth bouncy dough forms. Place dough into a clean oiled bowl, rubbing a little oil on the surface of the dough too. Wrap the bowl with a few hand towels to stay warm and leave for 1 hour to rise.
Finely chop the chocolate bar into small pieces and put into a medium sized bowl.

Warm the cream in the microwave or on the stove top, just until the cream starts steaming, not boiling. Pour cream all over the chocolate and quickly use a plate to cover the bowl for 3 mins, don’t touch. Use a whisk and start mixing from the centre, until silky smooth chocolate appears.
Add your reserved egg yolk, pinch of salt, vanilla extract and mix well. Pour onto a small tray or shallow pasta bowl and leave in the refrigerator until needed.

Flour the dough and punch the center of the dough, then divide into 10 pieces or (56g) if you want to be exact. Sprinkle more flour to prevent stickage, now shape into balls then flatten into discs and leave for 5 mins covered with a tea towel - this lets the dough relax and make it easier for shaping.
In the meantime, cut out 10 pieces of baking paper, roughly the size of your palm.
Roll out each disc into a large circle slightly bigger than your palm, repeat until all discs are rolled.

Dollop a tbsp of chocolate filling into the centre of the circle, do not touch the edges of the dough, or it will be harder to seal. Now bring the opposite edges together and pinch very tightly to seal the chocolate inside - you can’t over pinch, seal it well! Turn the bao seam down and adjust into a ball shape if needed. Place on a piece of parchment then into a steamer basket. Repeat until there is no baos left.
Leave to rise in the steamer basket for 15 mins.

Grab a pot that fits the steamer basket snug, then fill it a third of the way with water. Turn the fire to high heat. After a few mins steam will escape, turn the fire to low heat and set a timer for 12 mins. Then turn the heat off and leave for 5 mins, no touching. Finally, reveal and carefully tear open gooey hot chocolate in a fluffy bao bun, delicious.

name: Chocolate Beetroot Cake Recipe
description: This Chocolate Beetroot Cake recipe combines the earthy sweetness of beetroot with the rich, deep flavours of dark chocolate, resulting in a moist and decadent dessert that’s both surprising and delightful. The beetroot not only adds a unique flavour but also contributes to the cake's incredibly tender texture, making it a perfect choice for those who love a good chocolate cake with a twist. Whether you're serving it as a show-stopping dessert at a birthday party or simply enjoying it as a treat with afternoon tea, this beetroot cake will impress with its rich chocolatey goodness. The addition of beetroot also makes the cake naturally moist, ensuring it stays fresh longer. Pair this with a dollop of coconut cream or a sprinkle of cocoa powder for an extra layer of indulgence. Perfect for lovers of traditional cakes looking to try something new!
instructions: Heat the oven to 160°C. Grease a 23cm springform cake tin with a little butter, then line the base with baking parchment.
Drain the beetroot, roughly chop it, then blitz to a thick purée in a blender or food processor. Set aside.

Roughly chop the dark chocolate for the cake, then transfer to a heatproof bowl with the butter. Melt together over a pan of barely simmering water (or in a microwave, zapping on high in 30 second intervals then stirring) until melted.

Measure the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, salt and bicarb into a large bowl, then whisk together. Crack in the eggs, add the beetroot purée, melted chocolate and butter, then whisk everything together until a smooth, rich chocolate cake batter forms.
Scrape the batter into your lined tin. Bake in the centre of the oven for 40-45 mins until risen, coming away from the edges and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave the cake to cool completely in the tin – this can even be done the night before and kept well wrapped.

Ganache time. Finely chop the chocolate for the ganache and put into a heatproof bowl. Cut the butter into small cubes, then add to the chocolate bowl. Heat the cream in a small saucepan or microwave until it’s just steaming, then pour evenly all over the chocolate and butter. Leave to stand for 1 min, then stir with a spatula until you have a smooth and glossy ganache.

Put the beetroot chocolate cake onto a serving plate then pour the ganache all over the top. Eat now while the ganache is slightly warm with some extra cold cream, or wait for it to set a little before tucking in. Either way is a win.

name: Chocolate Chilli Crinkle Cookies
description: The love child of a brownie and a cookie, the best of both worlds. They come together to make the ideal textural bite – chewy, fudgy, with a kick of chilli.
instructions: Preheat your oven to fan 160°C. Line two baking trays with baking paper, set aside.
In a small bowl, add the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, chilli powder and salt. Mix together until combined, set aside.
Chop the chocolate into small chunks. Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Once melted, stir through the cocoa powder and chocolate until fully melted. Set aside to cool down.
In a mixing bowl, add both sugars, vanilla extract and crack the eggs in. Whisk until the mixture doubles in volume, has gone pale and looks fluffy, 5-7 mins.
Whisk in the cooled chocolate mixture, then, fold in the flour until no streaks remain.

Working quickly, use an ice cream scoop or a tablespoon to drop 2 tbsp worth of batter per cookie onto the baking paper, using a round cookie cutter – if you've got one – to keep them in place, and making sure to leave plenty of room between each cookie. Flatten and smooth the top of each cookie slightly. Sprinkle them with flaky sea salt and bake in the oven for 10-12 mins, until the cookies are slightly domed and the exterior is shiny and has lots of cracks on them.
Let the cookies cool down completely before eating.

name: Chocolate Chilli Espresso Martini
description: This recipe will wake you up, all right. A chocolate chilli espresso martini that's as hot as it is delicious.
instructions: Place your martini glass in the freezer to chill then prepare your coffee and allow it to cool before you start mixing drinks.
Prepare your card template by slicing two thin lines out of a piece of card. This will be used later when garnishing.
Slice up one of your chillies to your spice preference.

Fill your shaker with ice, then go in with the Kahlúa, chocolate vodka, coffee and chilli. Shake vigorously for 15-20 seconds or until a thin frost forms on the outside of the shaker. Double strain into your chilled martini glass.
Using your card template dust the top of your drink with cocoa powder, then gently but firmly with one hand on the stem of the glass spin your drink. This should create a swirl pattern on the top.
Finish garnishing with a chilli if you like then enjoy!

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Meet our ultimate chocolate chip cookie recipe. Make extra to keep in the freezer and thank us later.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C fan. Line two baking trays with baking parchment. Roughly chop the dark chocolate into 1-2cm pieces.

In a bowl, whisk together the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt and set aside. In a separate bowl, use an electric whisk to beat the butter and sugars together for 2 mins until light and fluffy (if you're whisking by hand, it will take longer).
Add the eggs, one by one, to the butter and sugar mixture and beat until just incorporated. Add the vanilla and beat to combine.
Sift in the flour then gently fold to combine. Fold in the chocolate pieces.

When the dough has come together, break off pieces and form them into balls roughly the size of a golf ball. Pop them on your prepared baking trays, leaving a good 8cm between them. Gently press down on each one then sprinkle the tops with the salt.

Slide into the oven to bake for 8 mins then remove from the oven and gently press each cookie flat with a spatula (this is optional – you may prefer to leave them to rise slightly). Return to the oven to bake for another 3–5 mins, or until lightly brown.
Remove from the oven and leave the cookies to cool on the tray for 10 mins before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Chocolate Chunk Brownies
